eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Lensingo leselibhidini lesimanje lekutjuza echweni inemakhona lamabili lanesikhala emkhatsini wawo. Lamakhona lamabili avumela kutsi ilibambe kahle lichwa, ngisho noma lishelela.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Ngenca yekutsi ngaphansi lolusingo lutjekile kancane, njengoba lolusingo lugucuka kusuka kulolunye luhlangotsi kuya kulololunye, lesiphetfo sawo lesitsintsa lelichwa naso siyagobeka.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Loku kubangela kutsi lamasodvo ahambe. Nangabe tinyawo takho titjekela ngesekudla, nalamasondvo logibele kuwo aya ngesekudla, nangabe utjekela ngesencele, nawo aya ngesencele.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Kuze abuyele akhanye ngelizinga lebekakhanya ngalo ngaphambili kufanele alahle emandla lengetiwe lawatfole kulokukhanya.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Bakwenta loku ngekukhipha kukhanya lokuncane lokubitwa ngekutsi "yi-photon".
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Bososayensi babita lenchubo ngekutsi "kuphuma lokukhutsatako kwemisebe" ngoba lama-atom akhishwa ngulokukhanya, bese sekabangela kutsi kuphume lemisebe yekukhanya.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Lesitfombe lesilandzelako sikhombisa ema-athomu akhokha emafothoni. Ngalokungangabateki, mbambambamba emafothoni mancane kunalawo lowabona kulesitfombe.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Emaphrothoni mancane kakhulu ngisho kunetintfo letakha ema-athomu!
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Ngemuva kwema-awa lamanyenti alungisa intsambo elambini ngekuhamba kwesikhatsi lelilambu lishile futsi langasasebenti.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Lelilambu lekukhanyisa shotsi lidzinga kushintjwa. Kumcokwa kutsi ube nebunono nawushintja lelilambu lekukhanyisa.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Kwekucala, iswishi yalelilambu kufanele icishwe noma intsambo ikhishwe.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Loku kungenca yekutsi gesi longena kusokhethi lapho loku lokuyinsimbi kwalegilobhu kuhlala khona ungakudlatfula nangabe utsintsa ngekhatsi kulesokhethi noma utsintsa lentfo leyinsimbi lapho legilobhu ihleli khona ibe legilobhu iselapha ekhatsi.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Sitfo lesimcoka kakhulu seluhlelo lwekutungeleta yinhlitiyo, lefutsa ingati.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Ingati isuka enhlitiyweni ngemitsambo yengati letibitwa ngekutsi ema-arteries bese ibuyela emuva enhlitiyweni ngemitsambo yengati lebitwa ngekutsi ema-veins. Imitsambo yengati lemincane ibitwa ngekutsi ema-capillaries.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Ematinyo e-triceratops kungenteka akhone kugaya hhayi kuphela emacembe kepha nemagatja netimphandze leticine kakhulu.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Labanye bososayensi bacabanga kutsi emaTriceratop bekadla sitjalo se-cycads, nalokuluhlobo lwesitjalo lesitayelekile ngesikhatsi sasemandvulo.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Letitjalo betibukeka njengesihlahla lesincane selusundvu tinemchele locijile, nemacembe lahlabako.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: I-Triceratops kungenteka isebentise umlomo wayo lonemandla kukhipha emacembe ngembi kwekudla umtimba wesihlahla.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Labanye bososayensi bayaphikisana ngekutsi lesitjalo sinashevu ngako kuyintfo lengakavami kutsi emadayinasosi asidla, ngisho nobe lamuhla letinye tilwane njenge-sloth kanye naletinye tilwane njengapholi (silwane lesivela kumadayinasosi) tikhona kudla titselo nemacembe lanashevu.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Emandla ladvonsela phansi ase-lo angangidvonsa njani mine? Nawume phansi ku-lo, ungaba sisindvo lesingaphansi kwaleso longiso eMhlabeni.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Umuntfu sisindvo sakhe lesingemaphawundi langu-200 (90kg) emhlabeni singaba ngemaphawundi langu-36 (16kg) e-lo. Emandla ladvonsela phansi, enta sisindvo sibe sikhulu.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Lilanga lite lucwecwe lelingetulu longema kulo njengeMhlaba. Lonkhe Lilanga lakhiwa ngemagesi, umlilo, kanye ne-plasma.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Lomoya uba muncane nawuchubekela khashane nemkhatsi welilanga.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Incenye lengephandle lesiyibonako nasibuka Lilanga ibitwa ngekutsi yi-photosphere, lokusho kutsi "libhola lekukhanya".
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Cishe ngemuva kweminyaka letinkhulungwane letintsatfu, nga-1610, umTaliyane losati setinkhanyeti longuGalileo Galilei wasebentisa sibonakudze kuze abone kutsi i-Venus inetigaba, njengoba nje nenyeti inato.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Inyanga ibonakala nangabe incenye yayo lebuke ngaseLangeni ikhanyiswe lilanga (noma inyanga). Lokukhanyiswa kweNyanga kusekela lokwashiwo ngu-Copernicus kutsi emaplanethi ahamba ajikelete Lilanga.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Kwase, eminyakeni lembalwa leyalandzela nga-1639, i-astronomer lenguMngisi lubito layo kunguJeremiya Horrocks yabukela kuhamba kweVenus.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: INgilandi ibe nesikhatsi lesindze sekutfula ngemuva kokuphindze incobe iDanelaw.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Kodvwa nga-991 Elthered bekabhekene neViking yetimoto lenkhulu kunanoma nguyiphi kusukela kuyaGuthrum eminyakeni lelikhulu lendlulile.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Lelicembu laliholwa ngu-Olaf Trygvasson, indvodza yaseNorway lebeyitimisele kubuyisa live lakubo ekwenganyelweni yiDanish.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Ngemuva kwekwehluleka emphini ekucaleni, Ethelred wakhona kuvumelana na-Olaf, lowabuyela e-Norway kuze etame kutfola umbuso ngekuphumelela kwakhe.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: IHangeul iyi-alfabhethi lokungiyo kuphela lesetjentiswako ekuphileni kwamanje. Le-alfabhethi yasungulwa ngabo-1444 ngesikhatsi sekubusa kweNkhosi Sejong (1418-1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: INkhosi Sejong beyiyinkhosi yesine yeJoseon Dynasty kantsi ingulenye yalabo labakhontiwe kakhulu.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Ubite ngalokusemtsetfweni i-alfabhethi yeHangeul Hunmin Jeongeum, lesho kutsi "umsindvo lokunguwo weticondziso tebantfu".
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Kunetintfo letinyenti letikhulunywako ngekutsi Sanskrit waba khona kanjani. Lenye yato imayelana nekungena kwa-Aryan asuka enshonalanga angena eNdiya loweta nelulwimi lwakhe.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: SiSanskrit lulwimi lwemdzabu futsi lufananiswa nelulwimi lwesi-Latin lolukhulunywa eYurophu.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Incwadzi leyasheshe yatiwa kunato tonkhe emhlabeni yabhalwa eSanskrit. Emvakwekuhlanganiswa kwe-Upanishads, iSanskrit yanyamalala nje ngenca yalabaphetse.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Luwimini lwe-Sanskrit akusilo lulwimi lolulula futsi lunotsile, futsi lubonakele lungumtfombo wetilwimi letinyenti taseNdiya, njengobe nje nesiLatin singumtfombo wetilwimi taseYurophu njengesiFulentji kanye nesiSpanish.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Njengoba libutfo laseFrance laseliphelile, emaJalimane acala kulungela kungena esichingini saseBrithani.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Ikhodi yaseJalimane yetsa lokuhlasela ngekutsi "yi-Operation Sealion". Linyenti letikhali letinemandla taLelibutfo Lemphi laseBrithani lalahleka ngesikhatsi lelibutfo liphuma eDunkirk, ngako lelibutfo belite emandla.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Kepha iRoyal Navy beyicinile kuneGerman Navy ("Kriegsmarine") futsi beyingabhubhisa wonkhe emasosha labetfunyelwe yi-English Channel.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Kodvwa, imikhumbi lelidlanzana yeRoyal Navy lebekwe lapho kungase kuhlaselwe khona njengoba labamemeteli bebesaba kutsi batomitiswa kuhlaselwa kwesemoyeni kwemaJalimane.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Asicale ngekuchaza mayelana nemachinga eTaliyane. ITaliyane bekungu "bhuti lomncane" weJalimane neJapan.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Beyinelibutfo lelibutsakatsaka kanye nelibutfo laselwandle nalo belibutsakatsaka, ngisho noma bebasandza kwakha imikhumbi lemine lemisha ngaphambi kwalemphi.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: ITaliyane umgomo wayo loyinhloko bekukungena emaveni ase-Afrika. Kuze ingene kulawo mave, beyitawudzinga kuba nelibutfo lemasotja, njengoba belingakhona kuhamba eLwandle lwase-Mediterranean lingene e-Afrika.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Ngaleso sizatfu, bekufanele behlukane netisekelo taseBrithani nemikhumbi eGibhithe. Ngaphandle kwekwenta loko, timphi taseTaliyane bekungakafaneli tente lokunye.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Nyalo yiJapane. IJapane beyilive lelisichingi, njengeBrithani nje.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Imikhumbingwenya imikhumbi leyentelwe kuhamba ngaphansi kwemanti, ihlale lapho sikhatsi lesitsite lesidze.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Imikhumbingwenya beyisentjentiswa Emphini Yelive I kanye Nasemphini Yelive II. Ngaleso sikhatsi beyihamba kancane kakhulu futsi beyingakhoni kudubula endzaweni lekhashane.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Ekucaleni kwemphi ngalokuvamile beyihamba ngetulu kwelwandle, kodvwa nakucalwa kwakhiwa intfo letsite lebona indlela, sigaba nelitubane umkhumbi lohamba ngalo futsi ishaya khona, imikhumbi lehamba ngephansi yaphoceleleka kutsi ihambe ngephansi kuze ingabonwa.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Imikhumbi yaseJalimane lehamba ngaphansi kwemanti yayibitwa ngekutsi yi-U-Boats. EmaJalimane bekanelikhono lelihle kakhulu ekufuneni lemikhumbi yawo nekuyisebentisa.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Kulandzela kutsi emaJalimane abephumelela empini ngenca yekutsi abesebentisa imikhumbingwenya umhlaba awusabacini kutsi ungabavumela babe naleminyenti.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: INkhosi Tutankhamun, ngaletinye tikhatsi kubhekiselwa kuyo ngekutsi "King Tut" noma "The Boy King", ngulenye yetinkhosi leyatiwako eGibhithe esikhatsini lesiphila kuso.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Kuyatsakatelisa kutsi bekangacatjangwa njengemuntfu lobalulekile etikhatsini takadzeni futsi akubhalwanga ngaye eluhlwini lwemakhosi angesikhatsi sakadzeni.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Kodvwa, kutfolakala kwelithuna lakhe nga-1922 kwamenta waba ngulodvumile. Nobe emathuna lamanengi ngaphambilini agcekezwa, lelithuna leli lona lashiywa cishe lingakatsintfwa.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Letiningi tintfo letingcwatjwe na-Tutankhamun tigcinwe kahle, kufaka ema-artefacts latinkhulungwane lentiwe ngemathayela nangematje langakavami.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Kwakhiwa kwemasondvo e-spoke kwenta tincola tase-Asiriya taba melula, tashesha, futsi takulungela kugijima kakhulu kunemasotja naletinye tincola.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Imicibisholo lesuka eminsalweni yabo lebulalako ingahlaba idlule esivikelweni semasotja lekuliwa nawo. Cishe ngemnyaka wa-1000 B.C., ema-Asiriya enta impi yekucala yamasosha lalwa agibele emahhashi.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Leligama lelitsi calvary lichaza emasotja labekalwa agibele emahhashini awo, ngaleso sikhatsi bekusete tihlalo temahhashi ngako lelibutfo lase-Asiriya belilwa ligibele emahhashini lete tihlalo.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Sati emaGreki lamaningi lakabosopolitiki, bososayensi, nebahlabeli. Kungenteka lowatiwa kakhulu kunabo bonkhe kulesive nguHomer, losonkondlo loyimphuphutse lodvumile, lowabhala tincwadzi letimbili letiyincophamlandvo: letinkhondlo i-Iliad ne-Odyssey.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles na-Aristophanes kusengibo babhali bemibukiso labadvumile futsi imibukiso yabo itsatfwa njengaleminye lemikhulu emisebentini yekubhala emhlabeni.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Lomunye umuntfu lodvumile longumGriki losati setibalo teluhlobo lwe-Pythagoras, watiwa kakhulu nge-theorem ngekuhlobane kwemasayidi e-triangle.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Kunetintfo letehlukehlukene letishiwoko ngelinani lebantfu lelikhuluma siHindi. Kucatjangwa kutsi lolulwimi lusemkhatsini wekuba lwesibili nekuba lwesine lolukhulunywa bantfu labanyenti emhlabeni.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Linani lalabakhuluma lulwimi lwalendzawo luyehlukana kushiyane ngekutsi labahlobene kakhulu bayabalwa yini noma cha.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Kulinganiselwa kutsi bekunetikhulumi letilinganiselwa etigidzini letingu-340 kuya ku-500, ebantfu labatigidzi letingu-800 batalucondza lolulwimi.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: SiHindi nesiUrdu kusebentisa emagama lafanako kepha kuhlukile ngekubhala phansi; ekucocaniseni kwamalanga onkhe, bakhulumi bato totimbili letiliwimi ngalokuvamile bayevana.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Cishe ngelikhulu lesi-15, inshonalanga ye-Estonia beyingaphansi kwemfundziso yemasiko aseGermany.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Labanye bantfu baseJalimane labaphila ngekwetsembeka futsi labalalelako bebafuna kuletsa Nkulunkulu dvutane nebantfu bemdzabu, ngako bacalisa lulwimi lwesi-Estonia.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Kwaya ngetinhlavu temagama aseJalimane nenhlavu leyodvwa "Õ/õ" yangetwa.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Njengaloku sikhatsi sihamba, emagama lamanyenti labekabolekwa elulwimini lwesiJalimane ahlangana. Loku kwaba ngukucala kwekukhanya.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Ngekwemasiko, indlalifa yalesihlalo sebukhosi iya ngalokucondzile emasotjeni nayicedza sikolwa.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Kodvwa-ke, Charles wafundza enyuvesi yaseTrinity College, eCambridge lapho afundzela khona i-Anthropology ne-Archaeology, futsi ngekuhamba kwesikhatsi wafundza temlandvo, watitfolela 2:2 (idegree lengaphansi yesigaba sesibili).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles bekalilungu lekucala Lomndeni Wasebukhosini WaseBritish lowaklomeliswa ngesicu se-degree.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: ITurkey yaseYurophu (emphumalanga Thrace nobe Rumelia leseBalkan peninsula) ihlanganisa 3% welive.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Indzawo yaseTurkey ingetulu ngemakhilomitha langu-1,600 (1,000 mi) budze futsi ibe ngu-800 km (500 mi) bubanti, futsi imise kwemdvwebo lonetinhlangotsi letine letihamba ngatimbili letilinganako.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Indzawo yase-Turkey, kufaka ekhatsi emachibi, ivala 783,562 wema-square khilomitha (300,948 sq mi), ema-square khilomitha langu 755,688 (291,773 sq mi) angaseningizimu nenshonalanga ye-Asia bese nema-square khilomitha langu-23,764 (9,174 sq mi) eYurophu.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Indzawo yaseTurkey iyenta ibe live lesi-37 lelikhulu emhlabeni wonkhe, futsi iphose ilingane neMetropolitan France kanye neBrithani kuhlangene.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: I-Turkey itungelwetwe lwandle etinhlangotsini letintsatfu, ngasenshonalanga lwandle i-Aegean' ngasenyakatfo lwandle iBlack, bese kuba lwandle iMediterranean ngaseningizimu.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: ILuxembourg inemlandvo lomudze kodvwa inkhululeko yatitfola nga-1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Tincenye tamanje teBelgium betiyincenye yeLuxembourg esikhatsini lesendlulile kodvwa tabese tiba yiBelgian ngemuva kwa-1830 ngemuva Kwetingucuko taseBelgian.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: ILuxembourg beyiloku yetama kuba live lelingatsatsi luhlangotsi kodvwa beliphishekile kutotimbili timphi iMphi Yelive Yekucala neMphi Yelive Yesibili eJalimane.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Nga-1957 iLuxembourg yaba ngumsunguli walenhlangano leyatiwa ngekutsi Inhlangano yaseYurophu namuhla.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Incwadzi leyasheshe yatiwa emhlabeni yabhalwa ngelulwimi lwesiSanskrit. Ngemva kwekuhlanganiswa kwema-Upanishads, lolulwimi lwabese liyanyamalala ngenca yalabaphetse.
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Kutsiwe nga-1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel wakha incaba kuze akhumbule imphumelelo yakhe nakabhekene nemabutfo aseTibetan-Mongol.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Nga-1951, umlilo wabangela kutsi kusale tinsalela kuphela taseDrukgyal Dzong, njengalesitfombe saZhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Ngemuva kwalomlilo, lencaba lenkhulu leyakhiwe yagcinwa futsi yavikelwa, yasala yaba ngulenye yetintfo letikhangako ta-Bhutan.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Phakatsi nelikhulu lika-18 leminyaka iCambodia yatitfola seyivaleleke emkhatsini wemave lamakhulu langomakhelwane, iThailand neVietnam.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Base-Thai bangena eCambodia tikhatsi letinyenti ngelikhulu lesi-18 futsi nga-1772 babhubhisa iPhnom Phen.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Kuleminyaka yekugcina yelikhulu lesi-18 iVietname nayo yangena eCambodia.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Maphesenti lalishumi nesiphohlongo ebantfu baseVenezuela labangasebenti, futsi lunyenti lwalabo labasebentako basebenta ngendlela lengekho emtsentfweni.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Bantfu lababili Kulabatsatfu baseVenezuela labasebentako basebenta encenyeni yekusita, cishe munye kulabane basebenta emikhakheni lehlukene bese munye kulabahlanu basebenta kulima.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Umkhakha lobalulekile kubantfu base-Venezuela ngu-oyili, lapho lelive kungilo lelitfumela lo-oyili kulamanye emave, ngisho noma kuliphesenti linye nje kuphela lebantfu bakhona labasebenta kulomkhakha.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Phambilini ekutimeleni kwemave, solwati waseSingapore Botanic Gardens wasita kunshintja sichingi wasenta saba Ingandze Yelidolobha lenetitselo.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Nga-1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, loyiorchid hybrid, wakhetfwa waba yimbali yesive yavelonkhe.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Yonkhe iminyaka ngabo-October cishe tilwane letitigidzi letingu-1.5 letidla titjalo tiyahamba tiye ngaseningizimu, tewele Umfula iMara, tisuka etintsabeni letingasenyakatfo kuze titfole imvula.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Futsi uphindze abuye enyakatfo angena ngasenshonalanga, endlula emfuleni i-Mara, ngemuva kwetimvula tanga-April.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Sigodzi sase-Serengeti sine-Serengeti leyiPaki Yesive, neNgorongoro Leyindzawo Yekucocisana neMaswa Leyindzawo Yekugcina Tilwane Tesiganga leseTanzania kanye neMaasai Mara National Reserve leseKenya.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Kufundza kwenta imidiya lechumanako kudzinga kutsi wente tintfo ngendlela letentiwa ngayo nemakhono ngelisiko, kanye nangendlela letisetjentiswa ngayo eklasini lapho kunekuchumana (libhodi letindzaba, i-audio ne-vidio kuhlela tintfo tibe ngabononina, kucoca indzaba, njalonjalo.)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Kusebentisana nekwakheka kwentfo letsite kudzinga kutsi uphindze uhlolisise loko lokucabangako mayelana netintfo tekusakata futsi ufundze kucabanga ngendlela lecondzile.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Kusebentisana kwekwakheka kwentfo letsite kudzinga kutsi tintfo letihlanganiswako taloyo msebenti tikhone kuhlangana, kodvwa tiphindze natehlukanisiwe tibe yintfo levakalako.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Lokukabi ngetibuko tekubukela dvute kutsi le-focal complexity nelinani letintfo letidzengekako kutfola budze bema-focal kukhulu kunaletinye tibuko letivamile.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Loku akusabi yinkinga njengoba bantfu labakha emalensi batfutfukela esigabeni lesiphakeme ekwakheni emalensi.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Loku kubangele kutsi emalensi e-zoom akhicite titfombe letisezingeni lelisetulu naticatsaniswa netitfombe letivamile letiphuma kulamanye emalensi.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Lokunye lokungasikahle ngemalensi ekuzuma kutsi lesivinini sawo sivamise kuba sincane.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Loku kwenta emalensi langakaduli kube matima kuwasebentisa etindzaweni letinekukhanya lokuncane ngaphandle kwe-flash.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Lenye yetinkinga levame kakhulu nawuzama kushintja lifilimu libe luhlobo lwe-DVD nguloku-ovaskena.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Bomabonakudze labaningi bentiwe ngendlela yekujabulisa umphakatsi.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Ngaleso sizatfu konkhe lokubona ku-TV kunemincele lejutjiwe, etulu, phansi nasemaceleni.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Loku kwentiwa kuze kucinisekiswe kutsi lesitfombe simbonye sonkhe sikrini. Loko kubitwa ngekutsi kugcwalisa sitfombe esikrinini.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Kodvwa-ke, nawenta i-DVD, imincele yayo kulindzeleke kakhulu kutsi ikhatheke nayo, futsi uma ngabe lelifilimu linemagama lachazako ladvute nangaphansi kwayo, ngeke avele kahle onkhe.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Lisiko langesikhatsi sesikhatsi lesiphakatsi lalesigodzi ligcugcutele lomcabango, kwenta titfombe temlingo emidlalweni, emadzilini kanye ne-Arthurian.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Ngisho nekuba semkhatsini webantfu iminyaka leyinkhulungwane kumelula kubuyisa engcondvweni umsindvo neliphunga lemphi, kuva umsindvo wekugijima kwemahhashi emgwaceni kanye nekuva liphunga lekwesaba lelichamuka emigodzini yemajele.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Kepha ingabe indlela lesicabanga ngayo lesekelwe kulokwentekako? Kungani leticongo takhiwa kwasekucaleni? Tasungulwa futsi takhiwa kanjani?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Ngalokujwayelekile kulesikhatsi, Sigodlo iKirby Muxloe simane nje siyindlu lecinisiwe kunekuba sigodlo mbamba.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Lifastelo labo lelimanyako nelubondza loluncama bekungeke kumelane nekuhlaselwa lokuchubekako.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Ngeminyaka yabo-1480, ngesikhatsi icala kwakhiwa nguLord Hastings, lelive belinekuthula futsi kutivikela kwakudzingeka kuphela kubantfu labambalwa labebababulali.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Kulinganisa emandla bekuluhlelo lapho emave aseYurophu afuna kugcina bukhulu bemibuso yemave onkhe aseYurophu.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Lomcondvo bewungukutsi wonkhe emave aseYurophu bekumele afune kuvimbela live linye kutsi libe nemandla, ngakoke bohulumende betive kaningi bashintja tivumelwane tabo tekubambisana kuze kugcinwe lokulingana.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Impi yekutsi ngubani labefanele kubusa leyaliwa Spain yaba yimpi yekucala lebe umgomo wayo kukukhombisa kutsi ngubani lonemandla.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Loku kwakusho lushintjo lolubalulekile, njengoba tiphatsimandla taseYurophu besetingeke tikhone kucamba emanga batsi basemphini yenkholo. Ngako leMphi Yeminyaka Lengemashumi Lamatsatfu beyitawuba yekugcina kutsi ibitwe ngekutsi yimphi yenkholo.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Lithempeli la-Athemisi e-Efesu labhidlitwa nga-July 21, 356 BCE ngekutsi Herostratus alilumeke ngemlilo.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Ngekusho kwalendzaba, wakhutsatwa ludvumo lalutfola nganoma nguyiphi imali. Base-Efesu, batfukutsele, bamemetela kutsi ligama laHerostratus lingaphindze libhalwe.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Umlandzisi wetemlandvo longumGriki Strabo ngekuhamba kwesikhatsi wabhala leligama, lelesilatiko namuhla. Lelithempeli labhujiswa ngebusuku lobufanako nalapho Alexander lomkhulu atalwa.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Inkhosi Alekzanda yanikela yatsi italakha kabusha lithempeli, kodvwa umnikelo wayo waliwa. Ngekuhamba kwesikhatsi, ngemuva kwekufa kwa-Alekzanda, lithempeli lakhiwa kabusha nga-323 BCE.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Yenta siciniseko sekutsi sandla sakho sikhululekile uma usashaya emanothi kahle - futsi tama kutsi ungacinisi tandla kakhulu ngetingalo takho.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Ngalendlela ngeke udzinwe kakhulu. Khumbula kutsi asikho sidzingo sekucindzetela emabhathini ngemandla lamakhulu kute ukhulise umsindvo njenganawushaya ipiyano.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Kulenkositini, kutfola umsindvo lowengetiwe, usebentisa tifutfo leticindzetela kakhulu noma letinesivinini lesikhulu.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Bufihlakalo kusho kufuna kuhlanganisa tingcondvo ngakamoya nalabanye, bunikati nalabanye, noma kwati kwesigcino mbamba, bunkulunkulu, liciniso lakamoya, naNkulunkulu.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Lolokholwako ufuna kutivela yena, umuva, noma kucondza ecinisweni lelingcwele/nkulunkulu noma bonkulunkulu.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Balandzeli balwela kuphila ngetindlela letitsite, noma bente imikhuba lehloselwe kuhambisana naleto tindlela.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Bufihlakalo bungahlukaniswa kuletinye tinhlobo tenkholo letikholelwako nekukhulekela ngekugcizelela kwayo kwati kwemuntfu sicu lokucondzile ngenca yalokuhlangenwe nako kwakhe, kakhulukati labo labanekuthula, kucondza, injabulo, noma ngisho buntfu lobutfokotako.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: ISikhism sigodzi lesiseNdiya. Sesuka esigodzini sasePunjab ngesikhatsi selikhulu lesi-15 leminyaka endzaweni lenemasiko esiHindu.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: ISikhs itsatsa inkholo yayo njengaleyo leyehlukile kumaHindu ngisho noma bavuma kutsi isuka emsukeni wemaHindu nasemasikweni awo.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Sikhs ubita inkholo yabo ngekutsi yiGurmat, lokusho kutsi Punjabi "indlela yebantfu labafundzisa esontfweni". Bafundzisi basesontfweni babantfu labasisekelo labahlonishwako kuto tonkhe tinkholo taseNdiya kodvwa iSikhism ngiyo lebalulekile leyakha umgogodla wetikholelo teSikh.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Lenkholo yatfolakala ngelikhulu lesi-15 itfolwa ngu-Guru Nanak (1469–1539). Yachubeka ikhona iminyaka leyimfica.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Kodvwa, ngeNhlaba 1956, titsembiso taKrushchev tabekwa esivivinyweni lapho umbhikisho ePoland, tisebenti betikhonona ngekuswelakala kwekudla nekuncishiswa kwemaholo, washintja waba umbhikisho ngalokumelene nebuKhomanisi.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Ngisho noma ekugcineni, Krushchev atfumele tincola temphi kuze ente kube nekuhleleka, utivumele ticelo letitsite letiphatselene netemnotfo futsi wavuma kutsi kubekwe Wladyslaw Gomulka lodvumile kutsi abe ngundvunankhulu lomusha.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: I-Indus Valley Civilazation bekuyimphucuko yeBronze Age lesenyakatfo nemphumalanga yencenye yekhontinenti yeNdiya lehlanganisa cishe yonkhe iPakistan yesimanje naletinye tigodzi letisenyakatfo yemphumalanga nenyakatfo yenshonalanga ne-Afghanistan.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Intfutfuko yanotsa emadamini e-Indus River lapho ligama layo lisukela khona.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Ngisho noma letinye tifundziswa ticabanga kutsi njengoba imphucuko yayikhona ngesikhatsi seMfula i-Sarasvati losewasha, kufanele ubitwe ngekutsi yi-Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, njengoba labanye bawubita ngekutsi yi-Harappan Civilization, indzawo yawo yekucala leyembiwa ngabo-1920.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Lobubutfo bembuso wemaRoma basita ekutfutfukiseni intfutfuko yetemphilo.
eng_text: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Bodokotela bacala kucashwa iNkhosi Augustus yaphindze yakha iRoman Medical Corps yekucala yekusentjentiswa ngemuva kwetimphi.
eng_text: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Bodokotela bekuhlindza bebanelwati lemaphilisi ekulala lamanyenti lahlanganisa i-morphine lebuya kulokukhishwe embewini yesitjalo se-poppy ne-scopolamine lephuma embewini yesitjalo se-herbane.
eng_text: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Baba nelikhono ekuhlindvweni kwesigulane kuze kusindziswe kuphila kwaso egciwaneni lelibulalako kuphindze kusetjentiswe tintfo letitsite kuze kuvinjelwe kuphuma kwengati.
eng_text: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Emakhulwini lamanyenti eminyaka, umbuso waseRoma watfola inzuzo lenkhulu emkhakheni wetemphilo futsi wakha lolunengi lwati lesinalo namuhla.
eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Indlela yekugoca tintfo ngendlela lehlelekile inemtsetfo locinile wekutsi kungase kugocwe intfo yinye ngesikhatsi, tindlela letiyinkimbinkimbi tekugoca njengekugoca uyise emuva atikavumeleki, futsi tonkhe tintfo letigocwako tigocwa tiyiswe phambili.
eng_text: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Yasungulwa ngu-John Smith ngabo-1970 kusita emafolda langenaso sipiliyoni noma labo labanemakhono lalinganiselwe emoto.
eng_text: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Bantfwana bakhulisa kubandlulula besebancane kakhulu futsi loku kubandlulula kutsintsa indlela labatiphatsa ngayo.
eng_text: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Ngekwesibonelo bantfwana lababukelwa phansi ngekwebuhlanga kutsi abenti kahle esikolweni bavele bangenti kahle esikolweni ngemuva kwekwati kutsi babukelwa phansi ngenca yebuhlanga babo.
eng_text: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: I-MySpace iyiwebusayithi yesitsatfu ledvume kakhulu lesetjentiswa eMelika futsi inemaphrofayili langema-54 etigidzi kungunyalo.
eng_text: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Lewebhusayithi bantfu labanyenti bayinakile, ikakhulukati labo labafundzako.
eng_text: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Kunetintfo letinhle ngalewebhusayithi, letifaka ekhatsi kutsi ukhone kwenta likhasi lelikilasi lelingafaka ekhatsi ibhulogi, emavidiyo, titfombe naletinye tintfo.
eng_text: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Lelikhasi ungangena kalula kulo ngekufaka likheli lewebhusayithi nje yinye, lokwenta kube lula kulikhumbula futsi kube lula kubhala kubafundzi labangaba nebumatima kusebentisa i-keyboard noma kubhala emagama.
eng_text: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Kungalungiswa kuze kwentiwe kube lula kukufundza futsi kufakwe umbala lotsite ngendlela lokufiswe ngayo.
eng_text: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Sifo Sekungakhoni Kugcila "sifo lesihlasela ingcondvo kanye nemiva lesibonakala ngetimphawu letinengi letihlukahlukene letihlanganisa kungakhoni kulawula imiva nobe kutiphatsa kwakho, kungakhoni kugcila, kuba nemdladla nobe kuba nemandla".
eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Akusiko kukhubateka ekufundzeni, kodvwa kuphazamiseka ekufundzeni; "kutsikameta emaphesenti langu-3 kuya kulangu-5 ebantfwana, baze babe banyenti bafinyelele etigidzini letimbili tebantfwana baseMelika".
eng_text: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Bantfwana labane-ADD bakutfola kumantima kugcila etintfweni letifana nemsebenti wesikolwa, kepha bayakhona kugcila etintfweni labatsandzako kutenta njengekudlala imidlalo nobe kubukela bopopayi lababatsandzako nobe kubhala imisho lengenatimphawu tekukhuluma.
eng_text: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Labantfwana bavamisa kungena etinkingeni letinkhulu, ngoba "benta tintfo letiyingoti, bayalwa, futsi baphikisane neligunya" kuze basitwe endleleni labacabanga ngayo, njengoba tingcodvo tabo tingeke tisitwe tindlela letivamile nje.
eng_text: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: I-ADD itsikameta buhlobo nalabanye bontsanga ngoba labanye bantfwana angeke bakucondze kutsi kungani benta ngendlela labenta ngayo noma kungani babita emagama ngendlela labawabita ngayo noma kutsi lizinga lekuvutfwa kwabo liyehlukahluka.
eng_text: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Njengoba emandla ekutfola lulwati nekufundza kushintja njengalendlela leshiwo ngenhla lizinga lendzawo lapho lwati belutfolwa khona luyashintja.
eng_text: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Lendlela yekutfola imininingwane beyihlukile. Bekungenancindzetelo lehlala emuntfwini loyedvwa, kodvwa likhono lekukhumbula lokubhaliwe ngilo lekwakugcilwe kulo.
eng_text: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Ngekwengcikitsi, sikhatsi sengucuko sente lushintjo lolubalulekile endleleni yekufundza kanye nasekusabalaliseni lwati.
eng_text: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Ngalokungefani naletinye tilwane, ema-hominid akatisebentisi tandla kuhamba noma kutfwala imitfwalo noma kuviyela etihlahleni.
eng_text: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Sandla seshimpandzi nelunyawo kuyalingana ngebukhulu nebudze, kukhombisa lomsebenti walesandla kutfwala sisindvo uma ihamba.
eng_text: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Sandla semuntfu sifisha kunelunyawo, netingalo leticondzile kunetetinyawo.
eng_text: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Tinsalela tematsambo etandla letineminyaka letigidzi letimbili kuya kuletintsatfu budzala tiyakwembula loku kusukela ekuchumeni.
eng_text: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Labanye bantfu bakholelwa kutsi emaphupho etintfo tekutakhela angaba ngulakhatsatako mbamba.
eng_text: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Sizatfu lesiyinhloko salesimangaliso ngulomphumela walamaphupha lamahle lachubekisa lobudze besikhatsi emkhatsini wemave eREM.
eng_text: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Ngema-REM lambalwa ngebusuku lobubodvwa, lesimo lapho utitfola khona ulele futsi umtimba wakho welulama loko kuba yimvela kancane kutsi kukubangele tinkinga.
eng_text: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Loku kukwenta udzinwe kube shengatsi uvuswa njalo ngemuva kwemizuzu lengemashumi lamabili noma lengemashumi lamatsatfu ubukele i-TV.
eng_text: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Lomphumela uncike ekutseni ingcondvo yakho izama kaningi kanganani kubhudza lokucacile busuku ngabunye.
eng_text: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Tintfo atibahambelanga kahle baseTaliyane eNyakatfo ye-Afrika kusukela ekucaleni. Ngeliviki nje linye ngesikhatsi kumenyetelwa imphi eTaliyane nga-June 10, 1940, iBritish 11th Hussars beyitfumbe Fort Capuzzo eLibya.
eng_text: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Ekuhlaselweni kwemphumalanga yeBardia, emaBritish abamba Njiniyela Losetulu Welishumi Wase-Italy, General Lastucci.
eng_text: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Mhlaka-28 iNhlaba, Marshal Italo Balbo, loMbusi-Jikelele waseLibya futsi lobekufanele adle lifa laMussolini, wabulawa ngumlilo nakafika eTobruk.
eng_text: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Lomdlalo wesimanje wemafenisi udlalwa ngetigaba letinyenti, kusukela kubafundzi labafundza enyuvesi kuya kubochwepheshe nemcudzelwano we-Olimpiki.
eng_text: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Lomdlalo ngalokuyinhloko udlalwa bantfu lababili, lomunye adlale nalomunye.
eng_text: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Ligalufu ngumdlalo lapho badlali basebentisa khona tindvuku tekuyidlala kuze bashaye ibhola lingene emigodzini.
eng_text: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Migodzi lelishumi nesiphohlongo ledlaliwe ngesiwombe lesivamile, nokulapho badlali bebecala emgodzini wekucala bacedze koweshumi nesiphohlongo.
eng_text: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Umdlali lojikijela tikhatsi letimbalwa kulekilabhu kuze acedze lomdlalo uyaphumelela.
eng_text: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Lomdlalo udlalwa etjanini, nalotjani emaceleni alesigodzi uhhulwa ube mncane futsi ubutwa ngekutsi luhlata.
eng_text: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Luhlobo loluvamile lwetekuvakasha ngulelo loluhlotjaniswa nekuhamba: Tekuvakasha tekutijabulisa.
eng_text: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Lesi ngulesikhatsi lapho bantfu baya endzaweni leyehluke kakhulu kuleyo labahlala kuyo onkhe emlanga bakhibike futsi batijabulise.
eng_text: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Emabhishi, emapaki netindzawo temakamu tindzawo letivamile letitsandza kuvakashelwa tivakashi letitsandza kungcebeleka.
eng_text: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Nangabe umgomo walotsite kuvakashela indzawo letsite kwati umlandvo nemasiko ayo, ngako-ke loluhlobo lwekuvakasha lwatiwa ngekutsi luvakusho lwemasiko.
eng_text: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Tivakashi tingavakashela tindzawo letehlukene eveni noma tivakashele indzawo yinye kuphela.
eng_text: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: EmaColonist, abona lomsebenti, nawo acela kutsi kuciniswe.
eng_text: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Emasotja lacinisa letikhudla letiphambili ahlanganisa libutfo lekucala nelesitfatfu lemadvodza langema-200 aseNew Hampshire, laholwa boKholoneli John Stark naJames Reed (kamuva bobabili baba boGeneral).
eng_text: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Emadvodza aStark abegudle fenisi eme ngale kulelelinye live.
eng_text: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Ngekhatsi kwehla kwemanti lokuphansi kuvula umsele kulomfula iMystic ngasenyakatfo-mphumalanga yePeninsula, ngekushesha kwanweba lelidaladi ngelibondza lelitje lelifisha ngasekugcineni lokusenyakatfo kwalomngcengcema wemanti elwandleni loluncane.
eng_text: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley noma Stark wabeka sigodvo lesingemafidi langu-100 (30m) eceleni kwefenisi futsi wayala kutsi kube bete lodubulako adzimate endlule emasotja.
eng_text: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Lisu le-Melika litsembele ekufakeni kuhlasela lokuhlanganisiwe etindzaweni letintsatfu letihlukahlukene.
eng_text: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Jenene John Cadwalder utawucalisa kuhlasela iBrithani eBordentown, kuze avimbele kucinisa lengakwenta.
eng_text: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Jenene James Ewing utawutsatsa emasotja langu-700 emfuleni iTrenton Ferry, atsatse ngeludlame libhuloho ngase-Assunpink Creek futsi avimbele onkhe emabutfo latitsa kutsi angabaleki.
eng_text: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Lelibutfo lelkhulu lwekulimata lelingemadvodza lati-2,400 liwela lomfula emamayeleni layimfica enyakatfo neTrenton, bese lihlukana ngemacembu lamabili, linye ngaphansi kwaGreene nalelinye ngaphansi kwaSullivan, khona batohlasela ekuseni kakhulu.
eng_text: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Ngalolushintjo kusuka ekugijimeni libanga leliyikota kuya ekugijimeni libanga lelinguhhafu, litubane liba yintfo lengasiyo lebaluleke kangako futsi kubeketela kuba ngiyo intfo lebalulekile.
eng_text: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Kuliciniso kutsi ingijimi legijima tigaba letingetulu kwehhafu yelimayela, lengakhona nekutsi lamlandzelako amshiye ngesikhatsi lesiyimizuzu lemibili kufanele agijime ngelitubane lelisetulu kodvwa yonkhe imijaho idzinga kukhutsatela.
eng_text: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Leminye imicudzelwano yekugijima uze ungene kulelinye live ngesikhatsi sasebusika, ihlanganiswe nekujimisa incenye lengetulu yemtimba wakho, kuyindlela lekahle yekutilolongela umcudzelwano wekugijima.
eng_text: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Umkhuba wekudla kudla lokunemsoco nje kuphela angeke ukwente wente tintfo ngelizinga lelisetulu, kodvwa kungaba nemtselela etingijimini letisetincane ekuphileni kwato.
eng_text: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Kutigcina unemphilo lekahle futsi unemandla, kuticecesha kuze ujwayele kugcina umtima wakho unemanti, nekuvisisa tindlela letihlukene tekusebentisa tinsita kungasita tingijimi kutsi titfutfukise indlela letigijima ngayo tiphindze tijabule ngalomdlalo.
eng_text: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Libanga lelisemkhatsini akusiwo umdlalo lobitako; kodvwa ke, kunemibono lengesiyo mayelana netinsita letidzingekako kute udlale.
eng_text: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Tintfo letitsite tingatsengwa natidzingeka, kodvwa letinyenti titawuba nemphumela lomncane noma tibe bete nje sanhlobo.
eng_text: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Tingijimi kungenteka titive shengatsi titsandza umkhicito lotsite ngisho nanobe kute tinzuzo lotiniketako.
eng_text: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Ema-athomu acatjangelwa kutsi angulenye yetindlela letimcoka letisita kwakha titina tayo yonkhe intfo.
eng_text: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Libhizinisi lelilikhuni, lihlanganisa i-nucleus letungeletwa nema-elctron, ngendlela lefanako nemapulanethi latungeleta lilanga ngakusho kwemodeli leyentiwe yaba lula yaBohr - buka Sigaba 1.1.
eng_text: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Inyukliyasi inetintfo letimbili - emanyuthroni nemaphrothoni.
eng_text: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Ema-protons ane-positive electric charge kantsi ema-neutrons akanayo sanhlobo i-charge. Ema-electrons ane-negative electric charge.
eng_text: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Nawufuna kusita lomuntfu losenkhingeni kufanele ucale uhlolisise lendzawo lakwenteke khona lengoti kuze ucinisekise kuphepha kwakho.
eng_text: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Kufanele ubone kutsi lesisulu sime njani njengoba usondzela kuso netintfo letingasitfusa.
eng_text: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Nangabe kwenteka ulimala uzama kusita, ungenta simo sibe matima nakakhulu.
eng_text: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Lucwaningo lutfole kutsi kucindzeteleka, kwesaba kanye nekuba nelihamba endleleni lobukana ngayo nesimo lesitsite kuhlobaniswa nebuhlungu kanye nekukhubateka kulabo labahlushwa buhlungu bengemuva emhlane.
eng_text: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Bekubangelwe kucabanga nje, bekungasiko kucindzeteleka, bekaneluvalo lekutsi kungahle kube khona langakumbisi kahle kuletinhlelo tePA lebetenteka maviki onkhe.
eng_text: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Labo labatsatsa ingcenye njalo emisebentini badzinga kusekelwa njalo nakutiwa endleleni yekuva buhlungu lengeyinhle kuhlukanisa umehluko webuhlungu lobungemahlala khona kanye nekungativa kahle ekushukumiseleni umtimba ngalokuvamile.
eng_text: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Kubona, noma likhono lekubona kushiyana etintfweni letisebentisa imiva yekubona noma emehlo.
eng_text: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Kunetindlela letinyenti tekwakheka kwemehlo, kusukela ekwakhekeni ngendlela leyinkimbinkimbi kuye ngaloko lokudzingekako kuleyontfo lephilako.
eng_text: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Letakhiwo letihlukahlukene tinemakhono lahlukahlukene, titsintseka kuma-wavelength lahlukahlekene futsi tinemazinga lahlukene ebucili, futsi tidzinga kusebenta lokuhlukahlukene kucondza lokungenako netinombolo letihlukene titosebenta kahle.
eng_text: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Linani lisho kubutfwa kwetintfo letiphilako teluhlobo lolutsite endzaweni letsite.
eng_text: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Esibalweni sebantfu, uma bonkhe bafana ncamashi macondzana nesici se-phenotype labo bantfu batiwa ngekutsi ba-monomorphic.
eng_text: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Nangabe bantfu bakhombisa kuhluka esicini lesitsite kutsiwa ba-polymorphic.
eng_text: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Libutfo letintfutfwane lihamba futsi lihlale ngetigaba letehlukene.
eng_text: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Ngesikhatsi sekuzulazula, tintfutfwane letilubutfo timasha ebusuku futsi time emini kuze tiphumule.
eng_text: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Ikholoni icala sigaba sekuphila ngekukhatsateka ngesikhatsi kuncipha kudla. Kulesikhatsi, lekholoni yenta tilulu tesikhashana letishintjwako onkhe emalanga.
eng_text: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Lomunye walemibhikisho nemasi yalabatingeli itsatse emalanga langu 17.
eng_text: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Yini iseli? Leligama lelitsi seli lisuselwa egameni lesiLatin "cella" lelisho kutsi "indlu lencane", futsi lacanjwa kwekucala yi-microscopist lebeyibuka kwakheka kwe-cork.
eng_text: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Lingcamuza lingumtfombo loyinhloko wato tonkhe tintfo letiphilako, konkhe lokuphilako kwentiwe ngalinye lingcamuza noma lamaningi.
eng_text: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Emangcamuza ayintfo lesisekelo nalebucayi etifundvweni tetintfo letiphilako, ecinisweni, njalo nakukhulunywa ngawo kutsiwa "titina tekwakha kuphila".
eng_text: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Simiso semiva sigcina simiso semasotja emtimba sitfumela tigubhugubhu temiva emtimbeni wonkhe kugcina kugeleta kwengati kuchubeka futsi kungaphazanyiswa.
eng_text: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Lemifutfo yemiva ingatfumeleka ngekushesha kuwo wonkhe umtimba lokusita umtimba uhlale uphephile kunoma yini lewuhlaselako.
eng_text: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Tikhukhula ema-tornado tihlasela indzawo lencane kucatsaniswa naletinye tikhukhula letinemandla, kepha tingonakalisa yonkhe intfo endleleni yato.
eng_text: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Tikhukhula ema-tornado tidzephula tihlahla ngetimphandze tato, tisuse emabhodi etakhiweni, futsi tindizise timoto emoyeni. Ema-tornado lanemandla kakhulu atsatsa sikhatsi lesingaba ngetulu kwema-awa lamatsatfu.
eng_text: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Lesiphepho besinemoya lobowugijima nga-480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
eng_text: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Bantfu bebenta futsi basebentisa tibuko kubukela tintfo madvute tinkhulungwane tetinkhulungwane teminyaka.
eng_text: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Kodvwa, tibonakudze mbamba tekucala takhiwa eYurophu sekuyophela likhulu leli-16 leminyaka.
eng_text: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Lesibonakudze besinemalensi lamabili labekenta kube lula kutsi tintfo letikhashane tibonakale tidvutane futsi titinkhulu.
eng_text: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Umona nebugovu utawuhlale ukhona lentfo yenteka kanje  njalo ngesikhatsi bantfu labanyenti basitakala ngandlelatsite kukhona labatawenta bugovu batfole inzuzo lenkhulu.
eng_text: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Asetsembe kutsi, bantfu labaningi batobona kutsi lokuncono kakhulu esikhatsini lesidze kusebenta kanyekanye nalabanye.
eng_text: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Bantfu labaningi baphupha ngelusuku lapho bantfu bangaya etinkanyetini babone leminye imikhatsi, labanye bayatibuta kutsi kunani lengaphandle labanye bakholwa kutsi kukhona tidalwa noma kukhona lokuphilako kuleminye imikhatsi.
eng_text: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Kodvwa, uma loku nje kungenteka, ecinisweni ngeke kwenteke esikhatsini lesidze. Tinkhanyeti tisabalele ngalendlela yekutsi kube nemamayela latigidzi letiphindvwe ngesigidzi emkhatsini wetinkhanyeti "letidvute kwato".
eng_text: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Mhlawumbe ngalelinye lilanga, batukulu bakho batobe beme emhlabeni wetidalwa bamangele ngabokhokho babo bakadzeni.
eng_text: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Tilwane takhiwa ngemangcamzane lamanyenti. Tidla tintfo letsite futsi titigaye etiswini. Tilwane letinyenti tiyakhona kuhamba.
eng_text: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Tilwane kuphela letinetingcondvo (nomanje kungasito tonkhe tilwane letinayo; ijellyfish, ngekwesibonelo, ite ingcondvo).
eng_text: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Tilwane titfolakala emhlabeni wonkhe. Tiyagubha emhlabatsini, tibhukushe etilwandle, futsi tindize esibhakabhakeni.
eng_text: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Lingcamzane liyintfo lencane lesakhiwo futsi lesebentako (yalokutsite) lokuphilako.
eng_text: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Ingcamuza ligama lesitsatselwa kwelesiLathini lelitsi cella lelisho likamelo lelincane.
eng_text: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Nawungabuka tintfo letiphilako usebentisa imicroscope, ungabona kutsi tentiwe ngetikwele letincane noma emabhola.
eng_text: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, losati setintfo letiphilako waseNgilandi, wabona tikwele letincane entfweni leyakhiwe ngesigodvo yekuvala emabhodlela asebentisa sibonakudze.
eng_text: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Bekabukeka njengemakamelo. Ngumuntfu wekucala lowabona emangcamuzana lafile.
eng_text: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Ema-elementi nemakhompawundu angasuswa kulenye intfo ayiswe kulenye kepha angashintji.
eng_text: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Inayithrojini lengumoya solo inetintfo letifanako nenayithrojini lengemanti. Lelengemanti ishubile kepha lama-molecule solo ayafana.
eng_text: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Emanti angulesinye sibonelo. Emanti akhiwa tincenye letimbili tema-athomu e-hydrogen kanye ne-athomu yinye yemoya lesiwuphefumulako.
eng_text: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Inendlela lefanako neyekwakhiwa kwemangcamzana kungaba egesi, emanti, noma entfo lecinile.
eng_text: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Ngisho noma simo semtimba singase sishintje, kodvwa simo semakhemikhali sihlala sinjalo.
eng_text: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Sikhatsi siyintfo lekhona kitsi sonkhe, futsi sitsintsa konkhe lesikwentako, kodvwa kumatima kusivisisa.
eng_text: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Sikhatsi safundvwa bosomfundvo benkholo, befilosofi, nebesayensi tinkhulungwane teminyaka.
eng_text: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Sibhekana nesikhatsi ngeticheme tetentakalo letisuka esikhatsini lesitako, tengce linamuhla futsi tendlulele emuva.
eng_text: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Sikhatsi futsi siyindlela lesicatsanisa ngayo budze betehlakalo.
eng_text: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Ungatihambisela sikhatsi ngekwakho ngekutsi ubuke kuphindzaphindzeka kwetentakalo letingumjikeleto. Tento letingumjikeleto tintfo letenteka ngalokuphindzaphindziwe.
eng_text: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Emakhompyutha lamuhla avame kumosha titfombe nemavidiyo.
eng_text: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Bopopayi labasesigabeni lesisetulu bangentiwa kumakhompyutha, futsi kuyekhula kusentjentiswa kwaleluhlobo lwabopopayi kumathelevishini nakumafilimu.
eng_text: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Umculo utfebulwa kusetjentiswa bongcondvomshini labayinkimbinkimbi kwenta nekuhlanganisa imisindvo kanyekanye.
eng_text: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Sikhatsi lesidze ngelikhulu lesi-19 nelesi-20, bekukholelwa kutsi takhamuti taseNew Zealand bekungemaMaori, labekatingela tinyoni letinkhulu letibitwa ngekutsi ma-moas.
eng_text: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Lenkholelo yaveta umcondvo wekutsi bantfu base Maori bangena basuka ePolynesia balibutfo lelikhulu futsi batsatsa iNew Zealand kumaMoriori, basungula umphakatsi lolimako.
eng_text: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Kodvwa, bufakazi lobusha buphakamisa kutsi leMoriori beyisive selivekati laseMaori lelatfutsa lisuka eNew Zealand kuya esichingini saseChatham, batfutfukisa lisiko labo lelihlukile futsi lelinekuthula.
eng_text: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Bekunalesinye sive etichingini taseChatham lesi bekusive seMaori lesachamuka eNew Zealand.
eng_text: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Batibita ngekutsi maMoriori futsi kwaba nekulwa lokwenteka, kangangekutsi emaMoriori ehlulwa
eng_text: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Bantfu lababe nencenye emashumi eminyaka basisitile kuze sikwatise loko lesikwentile ngemandla etfu nelutsandvo lesibe nalo ngesikhatsi lesifanako ngebucotfo babuka bulukhuni lesihlangabetene nabo ngisho nalapho sehluleke khona.
eng_text: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Nasilalela loyo naloyo ateka tindzaba takhe, temndeni, netenhlangano, satfola kucondza lokumcokwa mayelana nesikhatsi lesendlulile nalabanye bantfu lababa nemtselela lomuhle nalomubi emasikweni alenhlangano.
eng_text: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Njengoba kucondza umlandvo wemuntfu kungasho kutsi sowucondza lisiko lakhe, kodvwa kuyabasita bantfu kubanikete umcondvo wekutsi bawelaphi kulomlandvo walenhlangano.
eng_text: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Nabahlola kuphumelela futsi baba nekwati ngekuhluleka, bantfu ngabanye nabobonkhe labangenelako batfola kakhulu ngalokujulile, kubaluleka, injongo, nemandla lalawula lenhlangano.
eng_text: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Kulesimo, kucabanga ngaloko lokwenteke kutemabhizinisi nemphumela lobe khona kusita bantfu kutsi batibone tinsayeya letinsha kanye neticondziso letinsha telisontfo lendzawo.
eng_text: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Tindzaba temphumelelo letinjena tehlisa kwesaba kwenta lushintjo, esikhatsini lesifanako takha tifiso letinhle tekushintja esikhatsi lesitako.
eng_text: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Indlela yekucabanga lephendvuphendvukako iyindlela yekusombulula tinkhinga letihlanganisa imibono lehlukahlukene nobe tindzima kute kutfolakale sisombululo.
eng_text: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Lokugcilwa kiko kulesisimo sengcondvo, sivinini, likhono lekucondza nekunemba, futsi kutfolakala kwemaciniso, kuphindzaphindza emasu lakhona, nekuhlanganisa imininingwane.
eng_text: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Sici lesimcokwa kakhulu salesimo sengcondvo ngulesi: kunemphendvulo yinye lengiyo mbamba. Ucabanga timphendvulo letimbili kuphela, lengiyo nalokungesiyo.
eng_text: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.
