text: Loluhlobo lwekucabanga luhlotshaniswa neluhlobo lolutsite lwesayensi nobe tindlela tekusebenta letisesigabeni lesikahle.
eng_text: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Bantfu labanaloluhlobo lwekucabanga bacabanga ngendlela letsite lehleliwe, bayakhona kukhumbula tinhlelo, kusombulula tinkinga nekusebenta ngekuhlolwa kwesayensi.
eng_text: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Bantfu basembili kakhulu kunato tonkhe tintfo letiphilako ngekufundza tingcondvo talabanye.
eng_text: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Loko kusho kutsi sekumelula ngatsi kucagela kutsi labanye bantfu bakucondza njani, batimisele ngani, yini labayikholelwako, yini labayatiko noma labayifisako.
eng_text: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Emkhatsini walamakhono, kubalulekile kucondza tisusa talabanye Kusenta kutsi sicatulule lokungenteka kube kungaboni ngaso linye.
eng_text: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Ngekwesibonelo, nawungabona lotsite ephula lifasitelo lemoto, ungacabanga kutsi uyayeba lemoto yesihambi.
eng_text: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Kungadzingeka kutsi ahlulelwe ngalokuhlukile kube bekalahle tikhiya temoto yakhe futsi bekuyimoto yakhe labekazama kungena kiyo.
eng_text: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: MRI imayelana ne-physicc phenomenon lebitwa nge-nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), leyatfolwa ngabo 1930 ngu-Felix Bloch (asebenta eNyuvesi yaseStanford) na-Edward Purcell (lobuya eNyuvesi yeHarvard).
eng_text: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Kuze kuphume lomsindvo emandla atibutse nama wavu e-rediyo enta kutsi ema-athomu akhiphe tintfo letisenta sibambe umsakato
eng_text: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Ngemnyaka wanga-1970, Raymond Damadian, longudokotela nasosayensi locwaningako, watfola kutsi kusebentisa i-magnetic resonance kulithulusi lekucilonga umuntfu nakelashwa.
eng_text: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Ngemuva kweminyaka lemine lilungelo lebunikati baniketwa, lelilungele belilekucala emhlabeni lelake laniketwa MRI.
eng_text: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Nga-1977, Dokotela Damadian wacedzela kwakhiwa kweMRI scanner yekucala "yemtimba-wonkhe" leyabitwa ngekutsi "Ayitsaniswa".
eng_text: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Kukhulumisana lokungajahi imphendvulo kugcugcutela sikhatsi sekucabangisisa nekutsatsa tinyatselo kulabanye.
eng_text: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Sivumela bafundzi kutsi basebente ngelizinga labo futsi bacondzise nelijubane lendlela labafundziswa ngayo.
eng_text: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Ngalokwengetiwe, kunekulinganiselwa kwesikhatsi lokumbalwa nakuchatsaniswa nesikhatsi sekusebenta lesikhululekile. (Bremer, 1998).
eng_text: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Kusetjentiswa kwe-Inthanethi nema Webhusayithi Emhlaba kuvumela bafundzi kutsi bakhone kutfola imininingwane labayidzingako ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi.
eng_text: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Bafundzi bangakhona kubuta bothishela imibuto noma ngabe kunini bese batfola timpendvulo ngekushesha kunekutsi bamele kutsi baze babonane buso nebuso.
eng_text: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Indlela yekufundza yangesikhatsi lesendlulile yenta kutsi kube nenkhululeko ngalokuphelele. Ayikho indlela leyodvwa yekufundza.
eng_text: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Kuze ufundze kudzingeka kube nesenteko bese kulesenteko utfola sifundvo bese ke uba nelwati.
eng_text: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Lokuhlangenwe nakho kwetfu kwanyalo nako konkhe lokutibambela matfupha nelwati lelukhishwako, tifundvo tethelevishini tikhombisa lesikhatsi sanyalo.
eng_text: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Labanyenti betfu batitfola babukela luhlelo lwamabonakudze lelisitjela ngenchubo lesingeke size siyingenele noma silusebentise lwati lesilitfola kuyo.
eng_text: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Ngeke nje sikwati kushintja imoto ngalokuphelele, sakhe umtfombo ebaleni letfu, sivakashele ePeru kuhlolisisa umonakalo wakadzeni, noma sishintje kubukeka kwendlu yamakhelwane.
eng_text: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Sibonga tintsambo te-fiber optic letingaphansi kwelwandle letichumanisa iYurophu nesethelithe ye-inthenethi, iGreenland ichumene kahle njengoba emaphesenti langu-93 elinani lebantfu bayakhona kungena ku-inthanethi.
eng_text: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Lihhotela lokulo noma lapho bakwemukele khona kutsi ulale (nangabe uhlala endlini yetivakashi noma endlini lengayodvwa lekhetsekile) kuyo ngalokuvamile itawuba ne-wifi noma utfole i-PC lechunywe ku-inthanethi, futsi tonkhe tindzawo tiba nayo indzawo lapho kutfolakala khona i-inthanethi noma indzawo lapho kutfolakala khona i-wifi yemphakatsi.
eng_text: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Njengobe kushiwo langenhla, noma nje leligama "Eskimo" lisavumeleka eMelika, litfolakala liyinhlamba kubantfu base-Artic labangabo baseMelika, ikakhulu eKhanada.
eng_text: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Njengoba ungase uve ligama lelisetjentiswa bantfu beMdzabu baseGreenland, kusetjentiswa kwalo kufanele bantfu lababuya kulamanye emave bakugweme.
eng_text: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Lesive lesihlala eGreenland sitibita ngekutsi ma-Inuit eKhanada nema-Kalaalleq (Kalaallit ngebuningi), iGreenlander, eGreenland.
eng_text: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Bugebengu nebutsakatsi kuvamisile kubantfu labavela kulamanye mave, akwatiwa kangako eGreenland. Ngisho nasemadolobheni, kute "tindzawo letineludlame."
eng_text: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Simo selitulu kuphela kwengoti labangakalungeli labatobhekana nayo.
eng_text: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Nawuvakashela eGreenland ngesikhatsi semakhata (kucabangela kutsi uma uchubeka uya ngasenyakatfo, kuba makhata nakakhulu), kumcokwa kuta netimphahla letifutfumalako.
eng_text: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Emalanga lamadze ehlobo angaholela etinkingeni tekungatfoli kulala ngalokwenele futsi kuphatamise nemphilo.
eng_text: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Ehlobo ubocaphela nembuzulwane luhlobo iNordic noma ingabangi kugula nayikulumile kodvwa iyanyanyisana.
eng_text: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Ngisho noma umnotfo waseSan Francisco kutsiwa welizinga leliphakeme emhlabeni futsi ukhanga tivakashi, umnotfo wakhona wehlukahlukene.
eng_text: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Tinhlobo tetemsebenti letinkhulu kunato tonkhe ngimisebenti yabochwepheshe, hulumende, tetemali, tekutsengiselana, netekuvakasha.
eng_text: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Kuvetwa lokuvamile kwemiculo, emafilimu, tincwadzi kanye nemasiko lavamile kusite ekwenteni lelidolobha latiwe emhlabeni wonkhe.
eng_text: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: E-San Francisco kwakhiwe tintfo letinyenti letitawuba lusito kubantfu labavakashile, emahhotela lamnyenti, tindzawo tekudlela, netindawo letisezingeni lelisetulu tekubamba imihlangano.
eng_text: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: ISan Francisco iphindze ibe ngulenye yetindzawo letihamba phambili kulamanye emave ase-Asia: lafaka ekhatsi iKorea, iThai, iNdiya, neJapan.
eng_text: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Kuvakashela eWalt Disney World kumelela luvakasho lwelukholo lolukhulu emindenini yeMamelika leminingi.
eng_text: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: "Lokuvakasha" kuhlanganisa kundiza kuyiwe e-Orlando International Airport, kuhamba kuyiwe ehhotela lase Disney, kucitsa sikhatsi lesicishe sibe liviki ngaphandle kwekusuka endzaweni yaseDisney, bese kubuywa ekhaya.
eng_text: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Ahlukene futsi angachazwa ngetindlela letehlukene kodvwa nguloku bantfu labasuke bakusho nabatsi "baya kuDisney World."
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Emathikithi lamaningi atsengiswa onilayini kusetjentiswa iwebhusayithi lefanele njenge-Bay noma i-Craiglist asetjentiswa kancane bantfu lebatsenga sebatongena.
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Ngisho lona kungumdlalo lovamile, awukavunyelwa nguDisney: nemathikithi awo angeke uwendlulisele kulomunye.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Kufaka emathende ekukhempa ngephansi kwe-Grand Canyon kufanele ukwente nawutfole imvume.

eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Ngesikhatsi setimvula (ngaNovember kuya kuMarch), lizinga lemanti litawukhula kakhulu neTimphophoma titawuba nemanti lamanyenti.

eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnon Krom, emakhilomitha lali-12 eningizimu-nshonalanga yeSiem Reap. Leli thempeli lelisentsabeni lakhiwa ngasekupheleni kwelikhulu lesi-9, ngesikhatsi kubusa iNkosi Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Lesimo lesidzabukisako salelithempeli nalokubukela lesichibi iTonle Sap kwenta lokucanca lelidvwala kube ngulokudzingekile.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Kuvakasela lendzawo kungahlanganiswa kahle ngekuhamba ngesikebhe kulomfula.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: I-Angkor Pass iyadzingeka kungena kulelithempeli ngako ungakhohlwa kuta nepasipoti yakho uma uta eTonle Sap.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: IJerusalema inhloko dolobha nelidolobha lelikhulu ka-Israyeli, noma nje lamanye emave Nenhlangano Yetive Letihlangene angaliboni njengenhloko dolobha yaka-Israyeli.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Lidolobha lakadzeni eTintsabeni taseJudiya linemlandvo lomangalisako lokhona kusukela etinkhulungwane teminyaka.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Lelidolobha lingcwele kutotintsatfu tinkholo talabakholelwa kunkhulunkhulu munye - emaJuda, EmaKhrestu nemaSulumane, futsi lisebenta njengesikhungo sakamoya, senkholo, nesemasiko.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Ngesizatfu sekubaluleka kwenkholo yelidolobha, futsi nakakhulu tindzawo letinyenti tase-Old City, iJerusalema iyindzawo leyinhloko yebavakashi kwa-Israyeli.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: IJerusalema inemlandvo lomningi, tinsalo letimbiwe netindzawo temasiko, kuhlanganise netitolo letigcwele letiphitsitelako, emakhefi, netindzawo tekudlela.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: I-Ecuado ifuna kutsi bahlali baseCuba batfole incwadzi yesimemo embi kwekungena e-Ecuador ngetindizamshini nobe ngaletinye tindlela tekungena khona.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Lencwadzi kufanele yentiwe ibe semtsetfweni Yindvuna Yetindzaba Tangephandle e-Ecuado, futsi ivumelane netimfuneko letitsite.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Letimfuneko tentelwe kutsi kube nekuhleleka kulabo lahambako emkhatsini walamave lamabili.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Bantfu baseCuba labasebentisa emakhadi aseMelika laluhlata kufanele bavakashele i-Ecuadorian Consulate kute bakhululwe kule mfuneko.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Iphasipoti yakho kufanele ibe semtsetfweni lokungenani tinyanga letingu-6 ngaphambi kwekutsi kufike lilanga lakho lekuhamba. Lithikithi lekuhamba nekubuya liyadzingeka kuze libe bufakazi bekutsi uhamba sikhatsi lesingakanani.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Kuvakasha kuyashipha uma nibaningi, ngako-ke nangabe uwedvwa noma unemngani munye, zama kutfola labanye bantfu nente licembu lalabane kuya kulabasitfupha litoba ncono linani lelibhadalwa ngumuntfu amunye.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Kodvwa, loku akudzingeki kutsi kube ngolukukukhatsatako, ngoba tikhatsi letiningi tivakashi tihlanganiswa ndzawonye kugcwalisa letimoto.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Kuyintfo leyentekako kutsi bantfu bakhohlise labanye babente bakholelwe kutsi kufanele babhadale imali lenyenti.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Lentsaba lenyukelako ilengemuva kweMachu Pichu ehlangotsini loluseNyakatfo, etitfombeni letinyenti taletindzala iyavela.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Kubonakala kwesabisa, futsi kuyehlela kuphindze kube matima kwenyuka, kodvwa bantfu labaphile kahle bangakhona kukhuphuka ngemizuzu lengu-45.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Titebhisi tematje tibekwe endleleni, bese lapho kukhuphukela khona tinsimbi tekubambelela tiniketa indzawo yekubambelela lesekalanako.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Ngekusho njalo, lindzela kuphelelwa ngumoya, bese uyanaka etikhuphukelweni, kakhulukati uma kunemanti, njengoba kungaba yingoti masinyane.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Kunemhume lomncane eceleni kwalapha etulu lokufanele wendlule kuwo, uphansi futsi kufanele utiminye kuze ungene kuwo.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Kubona indzawo netilwane tesiganga taseGalapagos ukwenta kahle nawuhamba ngesikebhe, njengoba nje naCharles Darwin akwenta nga-1835.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Imikhumbi lengetulu kwa-60 ihamba emantini aseGalapagos - lenebukhulu lobusukela kubantfu labasi-8 kuya kulabali-100 labagibela kuyo.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Bantfu labaningi babhalisela indzawo kusenesikhatsi (njengoba tikebhe kaningi tigcwele ngesikhatsi sekuphitsitela).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Ciniseka kutsi inkhapani lotoyisebentisa inelwati lolujulile ngetihlenge nangetinhlobonhlobo temikhumbi.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Loku kutocinisekisa kutsi lolokutsandzako kanye/nobe bumantima bakho buyafanana nemkhumbi lolokufanela kakhulu.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Ngembi kwekutsi iSpanishi sifikile ngelikhulu lesi-16, inyakatfo yeChile yayingaphansi kwekuphatsa kwekubusa kwe-Inca ngekhatsi bantfu labangakaphucuki base-Araucanians (Mapuche) bahlala phakatsi naseningizimu yeChile.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: EmaMapuche nawo bekangulelinye lemacembu emdzabu emaMelika latimele, langangeniswanga ngalokugcwele embusweni lokhuluma Sipanishi kwaze kwaba ngulapho iChile itfola inkhululeko.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Ngisho noma i-Chile yamemetela inkhululeko nga-1810 (emkhatsini wemphi ya-Napoleon leyashiya live lase-Spain lite hulumende losebentako iminyaka letsite), kuncoba lokuphumelelako e-Spain kwakungakatfolakali kwaze kwaba ngu-1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: I-Dominican Republic (ngeSipanishi: República Dominicana) ilive laseCaribbean lelisebentisa hhafu losemphumalanga yesichingi saseHispaniola, leyisebentisa kanyekanye neHaiti.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Ngaphandle kwemabhishi lanemhlabatsi lomhlophe nemawa etintsaba, lelive lilikhaya lelidolobha lelidzala eYurophu eMelika, nyalo leseyiyincenye yeSanto Domingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Lesichingi kwekucala bekuhlala kiso emaTaínos nemaCaribes. EmaCaribes bekabantfu lebebakhuluma si-Arawaka labafika cishe nga-10,000 BCE.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Ngemuva kweminyaka lembalwa kulandzela kufika kwebahloli bemave lababuya eYurophu, linani lebantfu baseTainos lancishiswa bancobi baseSpain.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Ngekuya kwaFray Bartolome de las Casaa (Tratado de las Indias) emkhatsini wa-1492 na-1498 bancobi beSipanishi babulale langaba ngu-100,000 wemaTrainos.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardin de la Union. Lomkhatsi wakhiwa njengemhume wakhelwa indlu yebaPhristi yangelikhulu lesi-17 leminyaka, lapho iTemplo de San Diego kungiso sodvwa sakhiwo lesisele.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Nyalo kusebenta njengeplaza lesemkhatsini, futsi kunetintfo letinyenti letentekako, emini nasebusuku.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Kunetidzawo letinyenti tekudlela letiseceleni kwalengadze, futsi ntsambama nasebusuku kuvame kuba nemakhonsathi amahhala laba khona kuletindzawo.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Liphaseji Lekucabuza). Tibondza letimbili letihlukaniswe ngemasentimitha langu-69 kuphela likhaya lelutsandvo labosaziwayo bakudzala.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Nawubanike nje emasetjana lamancane labanye bantfwana bangakucocela indzaba.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Sichingi i-Bowen luhamba lwelusuku noma kuvakasha kwemphelasontfo lokudvume ngekuniketa i-kayaking, kucanca tindzawo temvelo, titolo, titolo tekudla, nalokunye lokunyenti.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Lommango useHowe Sound nawuphuma nje eVancouver, futsi kungeneka kalula kuwo nawuhamba ngemkhumbi losuka eGranville Island eVancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Kulabo labajabulela kwenta imidlalo yangephandle, luhambo lolusuka elwandle luya esibhabhakani lubalulekile.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: IWhistler (uhamba 1.5 wema-awa nawusuka eVancouver) iyabita kodvwa yatiwa kakhulu ngenca yemidlalo yaSebusika yema-Oliphiki nga-2010.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Ebusika, jabulela kuhamba echweni eNyakatfo yaseMelika, bese kutsi ehlobo wetame kuhamba ngelibhayisikili etintsabeni.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Timvume kumelwe ticelwe ngaphambili. Kufanele ube nemvume nawufuna kuhlala busuku bonkhe eSirena.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena ngiyo kuphela indzawo lapho ungakhona kulala khona futsi udle nekudla lokushisako ngetulu nje kwekukhempa. E-La Leona, San Pedrillo utfola kuphela indzawo yekukhempa awukutfoli kudla khona.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Kungenteka kutsi utfole imvume yekungena epaki ngalokucondzile eRanger Station ePuerto Jiménez, kodvwa abawemukeli emakhadi ekubhadala ngesikweledi.
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Indlela Yekusebenta yalePaki (MINAE) ayiniketi bantfu imvume yekungena kulepaki kusesele sikhatsi lesingetulu kwenyanga kutsi bavakashe.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: ICafeNet El Sol iniketa ngelitfuba lokutfola lusito ngemali lengu-US$30, nobe $10 lilanga linye; imininingwane iyatfolakala ekhasini labo leCorcovado.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Lesichingi saseCook sichingi selive lesisebentisana neNew Zealand, sitfolakala ePolynesia, phakatsi neNingizimu yeLulwandle lwasePacific.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Sichingi lesinetichingi letingu-15 letisakateke ngetulu kwetigidzi letingu-2.2 km2 kulolwandle.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Njengoba tihambisana ngetikhatsi neHawaii, tichingi ngaletinye tikhatsi kucatjangwa kutsi "tase-Hawaii".
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Noma kukuncane, kungikhumbuta letinye tivakashi letikhulile taseHawaii ngemuva kwebubusi ngaphandle kwalamahhotela lamakhulu etivakashi nalokunye kutfutfuka.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Lesichingi saseCook site emadolobha kodvwa sinetichingi letingu 15 letehlukene. Lesiyinhloko yiRarotonga kanye ne-Aitutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Emaveni lasetfutfukile lamuhla, kuniketela ngendzawo yekulala nekudla kwasekuseni sekuphendvulwe kwaba luhlobo lolutsite lwebuciko.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Ngasekugcineni, tindzawo tekulala nekudla kwasekuseni tachudzelana ngetintfo letimbili letiyinhloko: kwekulala nokudla kwasekuseni.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Ngendlela lefanele, etakhiweni letinhle kanjena umuntfu angatfola tintfo takanokusho tembhedze, mhlawumbe likhwilithi lelitfungwe ngetandla noma umbhedze wakadzeni lonelinani lelihle.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Kudla kwasekuseni kungaba sidlo lesitsandvwako kuleso sigodzi sangaleso sikhatsi semnyaka noma sidlo selikhetselo lesitsandvwa nguloyo lonimemile.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Kungaba sakhiwo semlandvo sakadzeni lesinefenisha yakadzeni, ligceke lelilungiswe kahle nelidamu lekubhukusha.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Kungena emotweni yakho futsi utsatse luhambo loludze kalula nje kuyajabulisa ngekhatsi ekuphileni kwemuntfu.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Ngalokungefani netimoto letinkhulu, ngalokungangabateki soyakwati kushayela imoto yakho futsi uyatati tinkinga tayo.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Kufaka lithende endzaweni letsite noma edolobheni kalula nje kungadvonsa emehlo ebantfu ngalokungenasidzingo.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Ngalamafishane, kusebentisa imoto kuyindlela lekahle yekutsatsa luhambo kodvwa ngetikhatsi letimbalwa kuyindlela "yekukhempa".
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Kukhempa ngemoto kungenteka nawunekhumbi lencane nobe i-SUV, Sedan nobe Station Wagon lenetitulo letikhonako kulala phansi.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Lamanye emahhotela anetintfo temdzabu tasemandvulo letifaka ekhatsi bojantji besitimela netintfo letitfolakala elwandle; ngaphambi kweMphi Yelive Yesibili, ngelikhulu lesi-19 noma 20.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Lamahhotela bekalapho bantfu labanjingile nalabadvumile bangaleso sikhatsi bebahlala khona, futsi bekaba nedzawo lekahle yekuhlala nebusuku lobumnandzi.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Tintfo takadzeni letifakiwe, kungabi khona kwetintfo letinhle tesimanjemanje, kanye nekuba khona kwetintfo lesetigugile nako kuyincenye yalesimo sabo.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Ngisho noma ngalokuvamile lendzawo iyemuntfu lotsite, ngaletinye tikhatsi kulaliswa bomengameli labavakashile kuyo nalabanye bantfu lababalulekile.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Sivakashi lesinemali lenyenti singakhetsa indiza lehamba ijikelete umhlaba wonkhe, lehlukaniswe ngekuhlala kulamaningi alamahhotela.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Inethiwekhi yekwemukela tivakashi yinhlangano lehlanganisa tivakashi nebantfu bandzawo emadolobheni labatawavakashela.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Kujoyina le-network kudzinga nje kugcwalisa lifomu nge-inthanethi; noma lamanye ema-network aniketa noma adzinga lolunye luhlolo.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Luhla lwalabo labatawube baphetse luhlelo lubhalwa phansi ephepheni noma lutfolakale onlayini, ngaletinye tikhatsi linemininingwane letsite luphindze lubuketwe ngulabahambele.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Kuhlangana nebantfu uhleti ekhaya kwacala ngaBhimbidvwane 2004 ngemuva kwekutsi umhleli wetihlelo tekhompyutha, Casey Fenton atfole indizamshini leshibhile leya e-Iceland kepha bekete indzawo yekuhlala.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Utfumelele bafundzi umlayeto enyuvesi lesendzaweni futsi watfola linani leliphakeme letindzawo tekuhlala letingabhadalisi.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Emahostela anaka kakhulu bantfu labasha - luhlobo lwetivakasha letivamile tiseminyakeni yemashumi lamabili - kepha uhle utfola letinye tivakashi letindzala khona futsi.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Imindeni lenebantfwana ayikavami kubonakala, kodvwa lamanye emahhotela ayabavumela kutsi bangene emakamelweni latsite.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Lidolobha laseBeijing eShayina litobamba Imidlalo yaseBusika yema-Olimpiki nga-2022, lokutolenta libe ngelekucala kubamba yomibili imidlalo yema-Olimpiki yasebusika nasehlobo.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: IBeijing itophatsa kuvula nekuvala kwemicimbi yemidlalo yangaphakatsi yaselichweni.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Leminye imicimbi yekuntjuza echweni itoba seTaizicheng endzaweni yekutjuza leseZhangjiakou, lechele ngemakhilomitha langema-220 (emamayela lali-140) nawusuka e-Beijing.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Lamaningi emathempeli anemigidvo Yaminyaka Yonkhe lecala kusuka ngaNovember kuya emkhatsini waMay, lehlukana ngekuya ngekhalenda yalelo thempeli.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Leminingi imikhosi yemathempeli abungatwa uma ahlanganisa umnyaka noma lophetse ahlanganisa umnyaka noma leminye imikhosi lemayelana nelithempeli.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Imigidvo yasethempelini iKerala iyatsandzeka kuyibona, nekungena njalo kwetindlovu letihlotjisiwe, i-orchestra yelithempeli naleminye imigidvo.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Umkhosi Lapho Kukhonjiswa Khona Tintfo Temhlaba (leyatiwa nge-Worlds Exposition, noma Expo ngalokulula) ngumkhosi lomkhulu wemhlabawonkhe webuciko nesayensi.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Emave latsatsa incenye abonakalisa buciko kanye nemfundvo etindzaweni temphakatsi tesive kubonisa inkinga yemhlaba wonkhe nobe lisiko nemlandvo welive labo.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: I-International Horticultural Expositions ngimibutsano lekhetsekile yekukhangisa tintfo tasengadzeni nanoma yini lenye lehambelana netitjalo.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Ngisho noma ngekwaloko lokubhaliwe loku kufanele kwenteke njalo ngemnyaka (nangabe basahlala emaveni lehlukene), nasikhuluma ngaloko lokwenteka mbamba loku akwenteki.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Lemibutsano ngalokuvamile itsatsa kusukela etinyangeni letintsatfu kuya kuletisitfupha, futsi ibanjelwa etindzaweni letingemahektha langu-50.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Kunetindlela letinyenti tekwakha emafilimu letisetjentisiwe kuleminyaka leyendlulile. Kusukela kulavamile langu-35 mm (36 nanga-24).
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Kungaphindze kugcwaliswe kabusha futsi melula, futsi kufakwe netincumo letikhona ku-DSLR yakamuva.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Letinye tinhlelo temakhamera letimafilimu tisebentisa luhlelo lwe-6 x 6, lokukhulu nakakhulu ku-56 x 56 wemamilimitha.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Loku kwenta lesitfombe sibe sikhulu ngalokuphindve kane nasicatsaniswa nesitfombe lesinespoko saso lesingu 35mm(3136mm2 versus 864)
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Kushutha tilwane tasendle kuyintfo leyinsayeya kumshuthi wetitfombe, kuze aphumelele kudzingeka kutsi abe nenhlanhla lenhle, abeketele, abe nelwati nemathulusi lasezingeni lelisetulu.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Kushutha tilwane tasendle ngalokuvamile kutsatfwa kalula, kodvwa njengekushutha nje letinye tintfo letivamile, sitfombe saletilwane sikushiya ubambe wangephansi ngebuhle baso.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Nawushutha tilwane tasendle ngalokuvamile udzinga ilensi lendze, nakuba tintfo letinjengemhlambi wetinyoni noma tilokatana letincane tidzinga lamanye emalensi.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Tilwane letininngi letinhle kundzima kutitfola, kantsi emaphaki ngalesinye sikhatsi anemitsetfo mayelana nekutsatsa titfombe ngenhloso yekwenta imali.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Tilwane tesiganga tingaba nemahkoni nobe tibe nelulaka. Kantsi indzawo letihlala kuyo kungenteka ibandze kakhulu, ishise noma ibe kabi ekuphileni kwalesilwane ngandlelatsite.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Umhlaba unetilwimi letehlukene letingetulu kwa-5,000, lokufaka ekhatsi letingetulu kwemashumi lamabili letikhulunywa bantfu labangetulu kwetigidzi letingu-50.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Emavi labhaliwe ngalokuvamile kulula kuwacondza kunemavi lashiwo ngemlomo. Liciniso laloku siyalibona emakhelini, ngalokuvamile lokulukhuni kuphimisela kahle emagama awo.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Lamanyenti emave akhuluma siNgisi kahle, kantsi kulamanye ungalindzela lwati lelingakapheleli - ikakhuluati kubantfu labasha.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Tsatsa ngekweliso lengcondvo, nawungentanjalo, umuntfu wase Mancunia, waseBoston, umJamaica, newaseSydney bahleli batungelete litafula badla idina erestuarant eToronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Batjela labanye ngetindzaba tasetindzaweni labasuka kuto, letikhulunywa ngetindlela lethlukile.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Kutsenga kudla esitolo sekudla ngalokuvamile indlela lengaduli yokutodla. Ngaphandle kwematfuba ekupheka, kuncane longakukhetsa kwekutfola kudla lokuphekiwe.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Siyenyuka sibalo setitolo letinetinhlobo letingafani tekudla lokuphekiwe. Letinye tisebentisa tifutfumeti tekudla njengema microwave nobe letinye tindlela tekufutfumeta kudla.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Kulamanye emave noma letinye tinhlobo tetitolo lokungenani kunendzawo leyodvwa yekudlela, ngalokuvamile lengakahleleki kahle kodvwa lokutsengekako kuyo.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Yenta bese uphatsa emakhopi enchubomgomo netinombolo temshuwalensi tibe kuwe.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Kungadzingeka bakhombise i-e-mail address yalomuntfu wemshuwalensi netinombolo telucingo takulamanye emave kuze bagunyatwe futsi bafake sicelo sekutfola lokutsite.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Bani nalenye ikhophi esikhwameni sakho lenye ibe onilayini (titfumelele yona nge-e-mail, noma uyigcine endzaweni lebitwa ngekutsiwa "yi-cloud").
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Uma uvakashile unangcondvomshini lephatfwako noma ithebulethi, gcina ikhophi kumemori yayo noma kudiskhi (letfolakalako ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Futsi kuyasita kubanika inchubomgomo nemakhophi ekuchumana bangani labahambako netihlobo noma bangani labasemuva ekhaya.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: IMoose (leyatiwa ngele elk) ngekutalwa alinalo lulaka, kodvwa iyativikela uma ibona kuhlaselwa.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Bantfu labangati kutsi lesilwane lekutsiwa imooses iyingoti bangasondzela kakhulu kuyo batifake engotini.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Natsa tjwala ngekutikhuta. Tjwala butsintsa wonkewonke ngalokungafani, ngako kwati lakufanele ugcine khona kubalulekile.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Tinkinga temphilo lokungenteka ube nato sikhatsi lesidze nawunatsa tjwala kakhulu tingafaka ekhatsi konakala kwesibindzi ngisho nekungaboni emehlweni nekufa. Ungaba sengotini kakhulu nangabe unatsa tjwala lobungekho emtsetfweni.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Emaspirithi langekho emtsetfweni angafaka ekhatsi kungcola lokuningi lokuyingoti lokufaka ekhatsi imethanol, lengabangela bumphumphutse noma ngisho nekufa ngisho kufakwe kancane.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Tibuko temehlo tingaba nguletishiphile emaveni angephandle, ikahlulukati emaveni lakha imali lencane lapho tisebenti takhona tibhadalwa imali lencane.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Cabangela kutfola kuhlolelwa amehlo ekhaya, nakakhulu nangabe umshwalensi ukukhokhela loko, bese utfola incwadzi yadokotela legcwaliswe kwenye indzawo.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Emafreyimi laphakeme emagama emabrand lakhona kuletindzawo letinjena anetinkinga letimbili; lamanye mhlawumbe angemafreyimi mbumbulu, futsi lalangiwo mbamba langenisiwe mhlawumbe angadula kunewasekhaya.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Likhofi lingulomunye wemikhicito letsengwa kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele, nakanjani ungatfola tinhlobo letinyenti esifundzeni sangakini.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Noma kunjalo, kunetindlela letiningi letihlukile tekunatsa likhofi emaveni lamaningi emhlabeni lekutifanele kutizama.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Kuzuba etindzaweni letisemaweni (nobe kucanca) kuhlanisa kuya esicongweni sentsaba, leyomile nobe legcwele emanti.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Kuzuba etindzaweni letisemaweni kuhlanganisa tintfo letinjengekubhukusha, kukhwela intsaba kanye nekugcuma--kepha kudzingeka uceceshwe kancane nobe ukulungele ngokwemtimba kukwenta (sibonelo. nakuchatsaniswa nekuncanca lidvwala, kuntjuza ngaphansi kwemanti nobe kushwibilika echweni).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Kucanca tintsaba ngulokwentiwa ngephandle lokufaka ekhatsi kuhamba etindzaweni tetemvelo, ngalokuvamile etindleleni tekucanca tintsaba.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Lilanga lekuyokhwela intsaba lihlanganisa libanga lelingaphansi kwelimayela kuya emabangeni lamadze langahanjwa ngelilanga linye.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Kukhuphuka intsaba lilanga lonkhe uhamba endzaweni lengasimatima kangako kudzinga kulungiselela lokuncane, futsi noma ngubani lophilile ngekwelizinga lelisesilinganisweni angakujabulela.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Imindeni lenebantfwana labancane ingase idzinge kulungiselela kakhudlwana, kodvwa lilanga linye nje ungephandle lingatilungela ngisho netinswane nebantfwana labasafundza enkhulisa.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Emhlabeni wonkhe, kunetinhlangano leticishe tibe ngu-200 tekuhambisa bantfu babuke tindzawo. Linyenti lato tisebenta ngatodvwa.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: I-Go Running Tours letsetse sikhundla seGlobal Running Tours ihlanganisa labaniketa kugijima kwekubuka indzawo labaningi kumakhontinenti lamane.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Njengoba bekanamatsele kuBarcelona's Running Tours Barcelona kanye neCopenhagen's Running Copenhagen, ngekushesha wajoyinwa yiRunning Tours Prague lesePrague nalabanye.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Kunetintfo letinyenti lokufanele uticabangele ngaphambi kwekwenta lokutsite noma kwekuya endzaweni letsite.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Nawuvakashile gadza kutsi timo tingafani njengobe tinjalo "emuva ekhaya". Kutiphatsa, imitsetfo, kudla, kuhamba kwetimoto, emazinga, lulwimi nalokunye lokunyenti ngelizinga lelitsite kutohluka kunaseveni lakini.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Loku ngulokutsite lokufanele ukugcine engcondvweni, kuze ugweme kudvumateka noma kungayitsandzi indlela yasendzaweni yekwenta tintfo.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Tinhlangano tekusita tivakashi betikhona kusukela ekhulwini leli-19. Insitakuvakasha imvamiso ikahle kuyikhetsa eluvakashweni lelendlula lwati lwesivakashi mayelana nemvelo, emasiko, lulwimi noma live lelinemali lephansi.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Ngisho noma bameleli labanyenti banesifiso sekutsatsa labanyenti lababhukile, bameleli labanyenti bagcila kakhulu etindleleni letitsite tekuhamba, sabelomali siyehluka hluka noma tindzawo lokuyiwa kuto.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Kungaba kahle kukhetsa ummeleli lovamise kubhuka luhambo lokufanana nalolu lwakho.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Buka kutsi nguluphi luhambo lomdayisi layilukhulumelako, nobe kuwebusayithi nobe efasitelweni lesitolo.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Nangabe ufuna kubona umhlaba ngemali lephansi, ngekwesidzingo, indlela yekuphila noma sivivinyo, kunaletinye tindlela tekwenta loko.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Ngekwesisekelo, kungena kuletigaba letimbili: ungakhetsa kusebenta ube uvakashile noma ungatama kunciphisa tindleko takho. Lesihlokwana sitogcila kuloku kwesibili.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Kulabo labafuna kulahlekelwa kunetseteka, nesikhatsi kuze bangabi nato tindleko, baba nemali lencane labayibekela kuvakasha.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Licebiso lisikisela kutsi bavakashi abantjontji, abangeni lapho kungangenwa khona, noma batsengise ngalokungekho emtsetfweni, aticeli, noma tirobhe labanye bantfu kuze tizuze.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Indzawo lapho uhlolwa ukhona ngalokuvamile kuba yindzawo yekucala loma kuyo nawehla endizeni, emkhunjini, noma kulokunye nje kwekuhamba.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Etitimeleni letiya kulamanye emave luhlolo lwentiwa ekhatsi kulesitimela lesihambako futsi kufanele ube ne-ID lesemtsetfweni nawugibela leto titimela.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Etitimeleni letihamba ebusuku, emaphasipoti atsatfwa ngumholeli ungatophazamiseka nasowulele.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Kubhalisa kungulenye intfo leyengetiwe lefunekako nawenta ivisa. Kulamanye emave, kufanele ubhalise kutsi ukhona kulelolive nelikheli lohlala kulo etiphatsimandleni tendzawo.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Loku kungase kudzinge kutsi kugcwaliswe lifomu nemaphoyisa endzawo nobe kuyokufuna lusito emahhovisini ekutfutsela kulelinye live.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Emaveni lamanyenti lanalomtsetfo lofana nalona, emahhotela endzawo atawenta lokubhalisa (ciniseka kutsi uyabuta).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Kuletinye timo, ngulabo kuphela labangahlali etindzaweni tebantfu labavakashile lokudzingeka kutsi babhaliswe. Noma kunjalo, loku kwenta lomtsetfo ufihleke kakhulu, ngako tfola kusenesikhatsi.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: I-Architecture imayelana nekudvweba nekwakha takhiwo. Indlela indzawo leyakhiwe ngayo yikona lokuheha kakhulu tivakashi.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Takhiwo letiningi tinhle kutibuka kantsi kubuka usetulu kusakhiwo noma ume endzaweni lekahle ngasefasitelweni kungabakuhle kubuka.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: I-Architecture itsintsa ngendlela lephawulekako leminye imikhakha lefaka ekhatsi kuhlela takhiwo endzaweni yasemadolobheni, bunjiniyela bekwakha, imihlobiso, kuhlela kwangekhatsi kanye nekuhlela indlela indzawo letobukeka ngayo.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Nawucabanga ngekutsi akhashane kangakanani lamanye emadolobha, angeke ukhone kujabulela kucitsa busuku bakho kahle ngaphandle kwekutsi uye e-Albuquerque noma eSanta Fe.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Kodvwa, cishe onkhe lamakhasino labalwe langenhla ayatiniketa tinatfo, futsi lamaningi awo aletsa betekutijabulisa labadvumile (ngalokuyinhloko lalamakhulu latungelete e-Albuquerque nase Santa Fe).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Caphela: tindzawo tetjwala letincane lapha atisikahle kumuntfu losivakashi kutsi acitse sikhatsi khona.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Intfo lesiyatiko kutsi inyakatfo ye-New Mexico inetinkinga letinkhulu tebashayeli labashayela badzakiwe, futsi linyenti lalabashayeli labadzakiwe litfolakala emadolobheni lamancane lanetindzawo tekunatsa.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Imidvwebo yasebondzeni lengafuneki, noma kubhala emabondzeni kwatiwa ngekutsi yi-graffiti.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Noma kukhashane netimangaliso tesimanje, bantfu labaningi kungenteka bakuhlanganisa nebantfu labenta umonakalo emphahleni yesive neyemuntfu ngamunye basebentisa pende lofutsako.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Kodvwa, kuletinsuku tanyalo kunebadvebi bemidvwebo labadvumile, imicimbi yemidvwebo nemadvonga "emtsetfo". Imidvwebo lependiwe kulomongo imelela buciko kunemathegi langafundzeki.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Kujikijela i-boomerang likhono lelivamile lelo tivakashi letifuna kulati.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Nangabe ufuna kufundza kujikijela iboomerang lebuyela esandleni sakho, kufuna uciniseke kutsi leboomerang ngulekahle kutsi ibuye.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Lamaningi ema-boomerang akhona e-Australlia akabuyi. Kuhle kutsi labasacala bangazami kuphosa emoyeni.
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: I-Hangi Kudla lokuphekwa emgodzini loshisako ngaphansi kwemhlaba.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Lomgodzi kungenteka ushisiswa ngematje lashisako labaselwe, noma kushisa kwemhlaba lokwenta letindzawo talomhlaba tishise ngalokutentakalelako.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Esikhatsini lesinyenti lokosa usebentisa ematje kwentiwa nawosela bantfu ngendlela lesidzala.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Tindzawo letinyenti eRotorua tinetindzawo lapho kudla kuphekwa khona ngematje lashisako, tibe letinye tindzawo letinjalo tingaba khona eChristchurch, Wellington nakuletinye tindzawo.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: IMetroRail inemaklasi lamabili kutitimela letigitjelwako phakatsi nangaphandle kweCape Town: MetroPlus (lebitwa nge-First Class) ne-Metro (lebitwa nge-Third Class).
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: IMetroPlus ihlalisekile futsi ayikagcwali kodvwa iyabita kancane, noma ingabiti kundlula emathikithi e-metro leyetayelwe eYurophu.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Tonkhe titimela tinendzwo lebitwa ngekutsi yi-MetroPlus kanye nematrogo labitwa ngekutsi ma-Metro; ema-MetroPlus ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi atfolakala ekugcineni kwesitimela dvutane naseCape Town.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Kukhatsalela labanye - Ungalokotsi ubeke tikhwama takho lawungaboni khona, ikakhulu nawuwela lithaka.
eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Ungatikhandza usetjentiswa kushushumbisa tidzakamiva ungati, lokungakufaka kulenkhulu inkinga.
eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Loku kufaka ekhatsi kuma elayinini, njengoba tinja letimfumfutsa tidzakamiva tingasetjentiswa noma nini ningakatjelwa.
eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Lamanye emave sekacinise sijeziso ngisho nakubantfu lokukwekucala kutsi bente emacala; loku kungafaka ekhatsi kuboshwa iminyaka lengetulu kwa-10 noma kufa.
eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Tikhwama letinganakwa tisematfubeni lamaningi ekwetjiwa, kani tingaphindze tidvonse emehlo alabaphetse kuletsa tinsolo tekusongelwa ngemabhomu.
eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Ekhaya, ngenca yekuchayeka njalo emagciwaneni asendzaweni, manengi ematfuba ekutsi ugcine umtimba wakho sewukhona kulwa nawo.
eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Kepha kuletinye tindzawo emhlabeni, lapho ligciwane le-fauna lilisha khona, nisematfubeni lamanyenti ekuba senkhingeni.
eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Futsi etindzaweni letishisako ligciwane landza ngekushesha futsi liphile sikhatsi lesidze nalingephandle kwemtimba.
eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Kanjalo lokuhlupheka kweDelhi Belly, kucalekiswa kwaFaro, Kutiphindzisela kwaMontezuma, nebangani babo labanyenti.
eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Njengetinkhinga tekuphefumula etindzaweni leticandzako, tinkhinga tesisu tetayelekile etindzaweni letishisako futsi etikhatsini letinyenti atitsandzeki kepha atisiyo ingoti.
eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Uma ngabe uvakashele live lelitfutfukako kwekucala - nobe eluhlangotsini lolusha lwemhlaba - ungakubukeli phansi kumangaliswa ngetemasiko longahle ukubone.
eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Kaningi sivakashi lesihlalisekile, nalesikhonako sihlulwe ngulokwenta tintfo kuvakasha kwemhlaba lokusatfutfuka, lapho khona kutilungisela lokuningi ngemasiko kungangeteleka masinyane.
eng_text: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Ikakhulu emalangeni akho ekucala, cabangela kusebentisa imali kakhulu Ngesitayela-sasenshonalanga kanye nemahotela lasembili, kudla, netinkhonzo letisita wetayele.
eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Ungalali phansi esiphonjini nobe kuyiphedi etindzaweni lapho ungatati khona tilwane takhona.
eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Nangabe nitolala ngephandle emathendeni, wota nembhedze wangaphandle noma ihamoki kubalekela tinyoka, tinyoka tebafati nalokunye lokufanako.
eng_text: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Ekhaya kakho akunatfwe likhofi lelimnandzi ekuseni bese kunatfwa litiya ebusuku.
eng_text: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Nawuvakashele edvute nasekhaya, unesikhatsi sekutentela tintfo futsi usebentise sikhashane lesengetiwe kwenta lokutsite lokukhetsekile.
eng_text: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Uma utiva ukhutsele nakakhulu, tsatsa lelitfuba kwenta ijusi noma kuhlanganisa emasmoothies.
eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: mhlawumbe utawutfola sinatfo lesimalula longasenta ngekudla kwasekuseni nawowubuyele ekwenteni tintfo ngendlela loyijwayele.
eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Nawuhlala edolobhenikati lelinemikhuba yekunatsa lehlukahlukene, yani emabhareni noma etinkantini etindzaweni letidvute longakavami kuya kito kakhulu.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Kulabo labangaketayelani nemagama lahambelana nakugula, ligama lelitsi letitsatselwanako nalelitsi letitselelwanako anetinchazelo letingafani.
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Sifo lesitsatselwanako sifo lesibangwa ligciwane kungaba yivariyasi ibhakthiriya ifangasi noma tilwanyana letimunya ingati.
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Sifo lesitsatselwanako sifo lesendluliseleka kulomunye ngekutsi abe sedvutane nemuntfu lesimphetse.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Labaningi bohulumende bafuna kutsi tivakashi uma tingena, noma bahlali baphuma, emaveni abo bagomele tifo letehlukene.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Letimfuneko tingase tiye ngekutsi ngumaphi emave lona lohambako lafuna kuwavakashela noma lacabanga kuwavakashela.
eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Lelinye liphuzu leligcamile leCharlotte, Nyakatfo Carolina, kutsi inekhwalithi leningi lesetulu imindeni lengakhetsa kiyo.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Bantfu labahlala kuletinye tindzawo ngalokuvamile bakhuluma ngebungani bemndeni njengesizatfu lesiyinhloko sekutfutsela lapho, futsi tivakashi tivamise kutfola lelidolobha kulula kulijabulela tikanye nebantfwana.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Kuleminyaka lengu-20 leyendlulile, linani letindlela tekunakekela umntfwana e-Uptown Charlotte likhule kakhulu.
eng_text: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Ematekisi akakavami kusetjentiswa imindeni yaseCharlotte, noma nje bangawasebentisa kuletinye timo.
eng_text: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Ubhadala kakhulu nangabe unebantfu lohamba nabo labangetulu kwabangu-2, ngako lendlela lena ingabita kakhulu ngaphandle kwesidzingo.
eng_text: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: I-Antarctica yindzawo lebandza kakhulu Emhlabeni futsi itungeletwe yi-South Pole.
eng_text: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Kuvasha kwetivakashi takulamanye emave kuyadula, kudzinga kutsi ube nemandla ngokwemtimba, kungenteka kuphela ehlobo kusuka kuLweti kuya kuNdlovana, futsi kakhulu kugcila ePeninsula, Tichingi naseRoss Sea.
eng_text: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Tisebenti letitinkhulungwane tihlala lapha ehlobo kumabhesi langemadazini lamane ikakhulu kuletindlu kuletindzawo leti; linani lelincane labo liyahlala nangesikhatsi sasebusika.
eng_text: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: I-Antarctica yindzawo lembonywe lichwa lelingu-2-3 km.
eng_text: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Batsandzi bekuhamba emoyeni ngasikhatsi baya emkhatsini nelive, kucanca tintsaba nobe kufika kuPole, leyo lenesisekelo lesikhulu.
eng_text: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: ISouth Pole Traverse (noma iHighway) ingu-1600 km kusuka eMcMurdo Station eRoss Sea kuya kule Pole.
eng_text: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Lichwa laso lihlanganisa kuchekeka lokugcwaliswe ngemafulegi. Kungahanjiswa kuphela tigulumba letikhetsekile, kudvonswe tihliphi naphethiloli naletinye tintfo.
eng_text: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Laba akusibo labo labahamba ngekushesha ngako kudzingeka batsatse luhambo loludze bagege iNtsaba iTransantarctic ngaphambi kwekutsi befike kulelitsafa.
eng_text: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Lokubangela tingoti kakhulu ebusika yimigwaco leshelelako, netindlela letiseceleni kwemgcwaco (tindlela talabahamba ngetinyawo) futsi kakhulu titebhisi.
eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Ngalokufushanisiwe, udzinga ticatfulo letinesoli lefanele. Ticatfulo telihlobo tivamile kushelela elichweni nasesitfwatfweni, nemabhudzi asebusika anekuhluleka.
eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Lephethini kufanele ibe ngu-5mm (1/5 inch) noma ngetulu, futsi lendvwangu itsambe ngalokwenele etindzaweni letibandzako.
eng_text: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Lamanye emabhudze anetintfo lapha ngephansi letiwenta angasheleli nawuwagcokile, futsi leyontfo ihlala kahle eticatfulweni letinyenti nasemabhudzeni, etitsendzeni nakusoyili yesicatfulo.
eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Titsendze kufanele tibe phansi futsi tivuleke. Sihlabatsi, indzawo lelibhucu noma leneluswayi (lokuyi-calcium chloride) ngalokuvamile lugcwala emigwacweni etindleleni kuze likwente kube lula kunyatsela.
eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Lichwa leliwako tintfo letivamile, tindzawo letehlelako tiba nalo nje kodvwa leliningi lehlela entasi.
eng_text: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Inkinga kutsi umkhitsiko uyanamatselana ngako udzinga kutsintfwa kuze wehle kantsi waze watsintseka ukhandza kutsi kuyawubese kuyatihhohlokela nje.
eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Ngalesinye sikhatsi intfo lesikhubekiso kulapho lilanga lifudvumeta lichwa, ngalesinye sikhatsi kuwa kwelichwa lelinengi, ngalesinye sikhatsi tehlakalo temvelo, ikakhulu bantfu.
eng_text: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Sishingishane ngumoya lojikeleza ndzawonye lote emandla lamakhulu, lotsatsa umoya losedvute uwujikelezise ndzawonye uphindze uwuyise etulu.
eng_text: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Tenta umoya lomkhulu (ngalokuvamile lohamba 100-200 wemamayela/ngeli-awa) longaphakamisa tintfo letisindzako utiyise emoyeni, utetfwale njengoba lesiphepho sendlula.
eng_text: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Kucala kungimisinga kusuka esibhakabhakeni, bese kuba "siphepho lesinemandla" nakufika emhlabeni.
eng_text: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: I-VPN Yemuntfu (inethiwekhi yemuntfu sicu yekutibonakalisa) iniketa indlela lencono kakhulu yekubonakalisa kusebentisana kwepolitiki kanye nemnotfo.
eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Bawati kahle emawebhusayithi latsite ngenca yetizatfu letinyenti: Emalayini e-Inthaneti bawahambisa ngalenye indlela, hhayi nje kuphela i-http.
eng_text: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Ngalokuvamile baniketa lusito loluphakeme nalolusezingeni lelisetulu. Bayashitja futsi kulukhuni kubahlola.
eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Letinkapane tetekuchumana ticamba emanga laphindzaphindziwe ngaloku, titsi "tivembela bugebengu".
eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Ecinisweni, emakhodi alesigodzi akanawo umtselela ekukopeni ngalokungekho emtsetfweni; i-CD lekopiwe kancane kancane itawudlala kunoma nguyiphi intfo ledlala ema-CD lapho i-CD lengakakopishwa idlala khona.
eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Inhloso lekungiyo kunika tinkampani kulawula timaketse tato; konkhe kumayelana nekushintjana ngemali.
eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Ngoba tincingo tihlanganiswe ne-Inthanethi, akunasidzingo sekutsi usebentise lucingo lenkhampani yalapho uhlala khona noma lapho uvakasha khona.
eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Futsi akukho lokudzingekako kutsi ube nako kuze utfole inombolo yendzawo kulommango lohlala kuwo; ungatfola isethelayithi longachuma kuyo i-Inthanethi etindzaweni tasemakhaya tase-Alaska bese ukhetsa inombolo lekhombisako kutsi usendzaweni leshisako yase-Arizona.
eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Esikhatsini lesinyenti, kufuneka utsenge inombolo yamhlabawonkhe levumela tincingo tePSTN kutsi tikushayele. Kutsi lenombolo yakuphi kwenta umehluko kubantfu labakushayelako.
eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: I-app yekuhumusha – iyindlela lekhonako kuhumusha ngalokutentakalelako umusho wonkhe iwususe kulelinye lulwimi iliyise kulelinye.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Letinye tinhlelo kulomkhakha tingahumusha lokubhaliwe kuletinye tilwimi tasemaveni angaphandle tisebentisa timpawu nobe tintfo letikhona mbamba eveni lapho khona loyisebentisako ebhekisa ifoni yesimanje kuleyontfo.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Tindlela tekuhumusha titfutfuke kakhulu, futsi manje ngalokuvamile tihumusha intfo letsite ngendlela lengiyo (futsi akukavami kutsi kuhunyushwe intfo lengevakali), kodvwa kuyadzinga kutsi kucashwe, ngoba kungenteka lokuhunyushiwe kungabi ngiko.
eng_text: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Lenye yema-apps ledvume kakhulu kulelihlangotsi yiGoogle Translate, levumela kuhumusha ngaphandle kwe-intanethi emva kwekutsi udawunilode lemininigwane yalolulimi.
eng_text: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Kusebentisa ema-apps ekuphenya i-GPS ecingweni lakho lesimanje kungaba yindlela lemelula kakhulu nalesebentisekako kuphenya tindzawo uma uvakashe kulelinye live.
eng_text: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Kungonga imali ngekutsi kungatsengwa emamephu lamasha e-GPS, noma ema-GPS latimele noma kuwarenta enkapaneni lerentisa ngetimoto.
eng_text: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Nangabe lucingo lwakho lungakhonekithi ku-inthanethi, noma lungabambi kahle, ngete lwasebenta kahle nobe lungatfolakali.
eng_text: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Onkhe ema gilosa agcwele lokwemakhadi kwekushaya lucingo, kusebenta kuto tonkhe tincingo noma icall box noma usebentisa lucingo loluvamile.
eng_text: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Ngisho noma lamanyenti emakhadi kukahle kushaya ngawo lucingo noma ngukuphi, lamanye ngalokukhetsekile akuniketa emanani laphasi ekushaya nawushayela emave latsite kuphela.
eng_text: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.
