text: Letinsita tivamise kufinyeleleka ngekushayela inombolo lengabhadalelwa longayishayela ngetincingo letinyenti ngaphandle kwekubhadala.
eng_text: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Imitsetfo lemayelana nekutsebula titfombe iphindze isebente nanakurekhodvwa ividiyo, futsi khona kungenteka isebenta kakhulu.
eng_text: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Nangabe kutsatsa sitfombe salokutsite akukavumeleki, ngako-ke ungacabangi nekucabanga kutfwebula ivideo yako.
eng_text: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Nawusebentisa ikhamera leyindiza lekutsiwa yidrone hlola kusengaphambili kutsi yini longakhona kuyitfwebula nalovumeleke kuyitfwebula noma kutsi kukhona yini letinye timvume lotidzingako.
eng_text: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Kundizisa lokwetindiza lokuncane kwekudlala eceleni kwesikhumulo setindiza noma lapho kunesicuku sebantfu khona akusiwo umcondvo lomuhle, ngisho nasetindzaweni lapho kuvumeleke khona kukwenta loko.
eng_text: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Etikhatsini tanyalo kuhamba ngendiza akukavamisi kubhukwa ngalokucondzile kusetjentiswa lenkapane yetindiza ngaphandle kwekufuna nekucatsanisa imali kucala.
eng_text: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Ngalesinye sikhatsi indiza lefanako ingabe nemanani lahlukene kakhulu ngako kuyasita kucatsanisa imiphumela nekubuka iwebusayithi yetindizamshini nawubhukhile.
eng_text: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Ngisho noma ungeke uyidzinge ivisa nangabe uvakasha sikhatsi lesincane emaveni latsite noma uyowenta ibhizinisi, kuya kulawo mave uyofundza kuwo ngalokuvamile kutawudzinga kutsi uhlale sikhashana kunekuya khona njengesivakashi.
eng_text: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Ngalokuvamile, kuhlala kulelinye live sikhatsi lesidze kutawudzinga kutsi utfole ivisa usengakayi kulelo live.
eng_text: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Kuze utfole ivisa nawungumfundzi lenchubo netintfo lokudzingeka ube nato tihlukile kunanawufuna ivisa yekuvakasha noma yekuyokwenta ibhizinisi.
eng_text: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Emaveni lamanyenti, utawudzinga kutsi ube nencwadzi lebuya kulesikolwa lotawufundza kuso, futsi ube nebufakazi bekutsi utawukhona kutisekela lokungenani kulomnyaka wekucala wetifundvo takho.
eng_text: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Hlola naleso sikhungo, kanye nemahhovisi ebantfu bekufika yalelove lofuna kucwaninga ngalo ngetimfuno letengetiwe.
eng_text: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Ngaphandle uma usikhulu lesimelele live, kusebenta emaveni ngalokuvamile kusho kutsi kumele ubhalise temtselo kulelive lokilo.
eng_text: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Umtselo ubalwa ngetindlela letingafani emaveni lahlukene, linani lemtselo liyehlukana kulelinye live nakuchatsaniswa nalelinye.
eng_text: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Emaveni lapho tifundza tinemandla ekutsatsa tincumo letibalulekile khona, njengeMelika neCanada, umtselo ubitwa ngekwetifundza nangekwendzawo lokuyo, ngako umtselo ungehluka sifundza ngesifundza.
eng_text: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Noma-nje kuhlolwa kweteluhambo ngalokuvamile kungekho noma kwenta ngekuhleleka nawufika eveni lakini, kepha kulawula kwasemagedeni kusengaba ngumsebenti.
eng_text: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Yenta siciniseko sekutsi uyakwati longakuphatsa nalongeke ukuphatse bese ubika konkhe ngalokusemtsetfweni.
eng_text: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Indlela lemelula yekucala kulomsebenti wekubhala ngetekuvakasha kuzama emakhono akho kuwebusayithi leyi-blog yetekuvakasha ledvumile.
eng_text: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Nasowukwati kufometha nekuhlela, ngekuhamba kwesikhatsi ungabese sowutakhela yakho iwebhusayithi.
eng_text: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Kuvolontiya uma uvakashile indlela lekahle kwenta lushintjo kepha akusiko nje kupha kuphela.
eng_text: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Kuhlala nekuvolontiya kulelinye live indlela lenhle yekwati lisiko lelihlukile, uhlangane nebantfu labasha, kufundza kabanti ngawe, utfole umcondvo lohlukile futsi utfole emakhono lamasha.
eng_text: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Kungase futsi kube yindlela lekahle yekwadzisa sabelomali kuze kuvunyelwe kuhlala sikhatsi lesidze endzaweni letsite njengobe leminyenti imisebenti yekuba livolontiya utfola indlu yekuhlala nekudla futsi labambalwa babhadala imali lencane.
eng_text: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: EmaViking asebentisa tindlela temanti temaRussian kufika elwandle iBlack nelwandle iCaspian. Letinye taletindlela tisengasetjentiswa. Hlola kutsi tikhona yini timvume letikhetsekile letidzingekako, lokungaba matima kutitfola.
eng_text: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: IWhite Sea–Baltic Canal ihlanganisa i-Arctic Ocean kuBaltic Sea, ingena ngeLake Onega, Lake Ladoga neSaint Petersburg, ngalokuvamile ngemifula nangemachibi.
eng_text: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Lichibi i-Onega inamatsele kuVolga, ngako kuchamuka ngeLwandle iCaspian lendlula eRussia kungenteka.
eng_text: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Ciniseka kutsi waze wafika endzaweni yetikebhe konkhe kutawucaca. Utawuhlangana nalabanye bagibeli betikebhe futsi batokunika imininingwane.
eng_text: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Ngekwesisekelo utofaka timemetelo letikhombisa kutsi ungasita, uhambahambe etikebheni, uye kubantfu labageza tikebhe tabo, utame kukhuluma nebashayeli bemikhumbi endzaweni letsengisa tjwala, njll.
eng_text: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Zama kukhuluma nebantfu labanengi longakhona kukhuluma nabo. Emva kwesikhatsi wonkhe muntfu utokwati futsi utozama kukukhombisa kutsi ngusiphi sikebhe lesidzinga lotsite.
eng_text: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Kufanele ukhetse indiza lovame kuhamba ngayo esivumelwaneni sekubambisana ngekucophelela.
eng_text: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Ngisho noma ungacabanga kutsi kukahle kujoyina inkampani yendiza lohlale uhamba ngayo, kufanele wati kutsi emalungelo laniketwako avamise kwehlukana futsi tindzawo lokugitjelelwa kuto tingaba nebubele kuletinye tinkampani tetindiza esivumelwaneni lesifanako.
eng_text: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Tindiza letifaka ekhatsi taka-Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways kanye neTurkish Airlines setihamba nakakhulu e-Afrika, futsi tiya emadolobheni lamanyenti lamakhulu e-Afrika ngemanani langasiwo lamakhulu nakucatsaniswa naletinye tindiza eYurophu.
eng_text: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Tindiza taseTurkey tindizela etindzaweni letingema-39 emaveni langema-30 ase-Afrikha kusukela nga-2014.
eng_text: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Uma unalo litfuba lekuvakasha hlola kutsi imali yekuya e-Afrika ngumalini nayicatsaniswa nemali longayibhadala kuhamba umhlaba wonkhe.
eng_text: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Ungakhohlwa kunenetela tindleko letingetulu tema-visa, ikhumbi yekuhamba, imoto yekukuhambisa, njll. kuleto tindzawo letingaphandle kwase-Afrika.
eng_text: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Nangabe ufuna kundiza utungelete umhlaba ngolokugvwele eNshonalanga neHemisphere, kukhetsa tindiza nalofikela khona kumbalwa ngenca yekubabente kwetindlela tekuhamba elwandle.
eng_text: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Kute i-alliance yetindiza lehlanganisa tonkhe totintsatfu tindzawo tekwewela lwandle ku Ningizimu Hemisphere (neSkyTeam ayihlanganisi ngisho yinye yaletindzawo tekwewela).
eng_text: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Kodvwa, iStar Alliance ihlanganisa konkhe ngaphandle kwemphumalanga Ningizimu Pacific kusukela eSantiago de Chile kuya eTahiti, lokuyindiza i-ATAM Oneworld.
eng_text: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Indiza akusiyo nje kuphela intfo longahamba ngayo nawufuna kungahambi ngeSouth Pacific nangaselwandle lasenshonalanga yeNingizimu yaseMelika. (buka lapha ngentasi.)
eng_text: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Nga-1994, lesigodzi sase-Armenia ngebuhlanga iNagorno-Karabakh yase-Azerbaijan yasusa imphi nema-Azeris.
eng_text: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Ngelusito lwe-Armenia, iriphabhuliki lensha yakhiwa. Noma kunjalo, awukho umbuso lowasungulwa - ngisho ne-Armenia imbala - ayizange ikubone loku.
eng_text: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Timpikiswano tahulumende esifundzeni liyachubeka nokonakalisa buhlobo emkhatsini we-Armenia ne-Azerbaijan.
eng_text: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Sifundza saseCanal (iDutch: Grachtengordel) isigodzi sengelikhulu lesi-17 leminyaka lesidvumile lesitungelete iBinnenstad yase-Amsterdam.
eng_text: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Sonkhe lesigodzi sihlelwe njenge-UNESCO Indzawo Yetintfo Temasiko Emhlabeni ngenca yekwehluka kwaso ngekwemasiko nangekwemlandvo, netindzawo taso tinguleto letihamba phamphili kulelive.
eng_text: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, lokusho kutsi Tindzawo Letinhlanu, yakhiwa tindzawo letinhlanu letincane taseRiomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza naseMonterosso letise-Italy etifundzeni taseLigura.
eng_text: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Babhalwe Kuloluhla Lwemhlaba Lwemagugu ku-UNESCO.
eng_text: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Ngemuva kwemakhulu eminyaka, bantfu bakha tindzawo tekuphumula emadvwaleni, indzawo lenyukelako leya etulu kwentsaba lebuke lwandle.
eng_text: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Incenye yebuhle balo kungakhoni kubambisana lokubonakalako ekuletseni intfutfuko. Imigcwaco, titimela kanye nemikhumbi lehlanganisa tigodzi, timoto atikhoni kufinyelela kuleto tindzawo.
eng_text: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: SiFulentji lesehlukehlukene lesikhulunywa eBelgium naseSwetzerland sehluke kancane kusiFulentji lesikhulunywa eFrance, ngisho noma sivakala futsi asikahlukani kakhulu.
eng_text: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Ikakhulukati luhlelo lwetinombolo ngesiFrench lesikhulunywa eBelgium naseSwitzerand sinetici letehlukile kusiFrench lesikhulunywa eFrance, nendlela yekubita lamanye emagama yehlukile kancane.
eng_text: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Noma kunjalo, bonkhe bantfu base-Belgium nase-Switzerland labakhuluma siFulentji ngabe bafundza siFulentji lesivamile eskolweni, khona batokhona kukuva noma ukhuluma usebentisa indlela yekubala ngesiFulentji levamile.
eng_text: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Etindzaweni letinyenti emhlabeni, kuphakamisa sandla kuyindlela yekukhombisa lutsandvo, lekhombisa kutsi "uyabingelela."
eng_text: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Kodvwa, e-Malaysia, lokungenani kuhlanganise bantfu base-Malaysia labasetindzaweni tasemakhaya, kusho kutsi "wota" lokufana nemuno wekukhomba logobene wakhomba umtimba, sento lesisetjentiswa kulamanye emave aseNshonalanga, futsi kufanele lusetjentiselwe lowo mgomo kuphela.
eng_text: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Ngalokufanako, sivakashi lesisuka eBrithani siya eSpain singase ngeliphutsa sitsatse kuvaleliswa ngekuphakamisa sandla (esikhundleni salomuntfu lovaleliswako) njengendlela yekutsi siphindze sibuye.
eng_text: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Tilwimi letiseceleni tilwimi tekutentela nobe letakhiwe kute kube nendlela yekukhuluma nebatfu lokungenteka bangakhoni kukhuluma kahle.
eng_text: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Behlukanisiwe elulwiminni loluvamile emkhatsini wetikhulumi, lokulwimi loluvamile lelibese likhulunywa kakhulu ngenca yesisizatfu letsite njengendlela yekuchumana emkhatsini webantfu labakhuluma letinye tilwimi.
eng_text: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Nakushisa emini, bantfu labahambako bangativa babulawa yinhloko lematima kube shengatsi bamanti (noma letinye tintfo).
eng_text: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Loku kungaba yingoti nangabe lesivakashi sifuna emanti, sidlale ngemandla aso nemanti lesiwaphetse lasele.
eng_text: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Ngisho nelugwadvule lolushisako lungabandza kakhulu ebusuku. Emakhata angaba ingoti mbamba nawute timphahla letishisako.
eng_text: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Ehlobo, ngalokuvamile, utawudzinga kugadza timbhuzulwane nangabe uncuma kucanca intsaba uhamba ngasemahlatsini emvula.
eng_text: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Ngisho nobe ushayela emahlatsini emvula, maminitsi lambalwa uvule sivalo usangena emotweni anele kutsi imiyane ingene nawe emotweni.
eng_text: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Umkhuhlane wetinyoni, noma i-avian influenza, ingangena tinyoni netilwane letincelisako.
eng_text: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Emacala langephansi kwenkhulungwane abikiwe ngebantfu; kodvwa lamanye awo aholele ekufeni.
eng_text: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Kaningi kufakwe bantfu labasebenta ngetinkhunkhu, kodvwa futsi kunengoti kulabo lababuka tinyoni.
eng_text: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Ngalokuvamile iNorway inetihosha nemagcuma langakuholela entsabeni ngaletinye tikhatsi akuholele entsabeni lebekile esicongweni.
eng_text: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Lamatsafa ngalokuvamile kubhekiselwa kuwo ngekutsi "yi-vidde" lokusho indzawo lenkhulu, levulekile lete sihlahla, futsi lete nemincele.
eng_text: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: ERogaland nase-Agder ngalokuvamile abitwa ngekutsi "hei" lokusho indzawo lete tihlahla lembonywe timbhali.
eng_text: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Lamaglesiya akemi kepha ehlela phansi kulentsaba. Loku kutobangela kuphahlateka, nekuvuleka kwemhlaba lokungahle kufihlwe mabhuloho elichwa.
eng_text: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Emabondza kanye neluphahla lemihume yelichwa angawa kantsi timfa tingavaleka.
eng_text: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Ngasekugcineni kwelichwa lelikhulu uma liphuka, iwa phansi noma uzube noma ugicikele ekudzeni nasekugcineni kwalo.
eng_text: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Linani letivakashi letiya endzaweni lesemagcumeni yaseNdiya tiba tinyenti ehlobo.
eng_text: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Kodvwa, kunebuhle nekutsandzeka lokuhlukile ebusika, titeshi temadvwala titfola sitfwatfwa lesanele futsi kunetintfo letinengi longatenta kufaka ekhatsi imidlalo yasesitfwatfweni.
eng_text: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Tindiza letimbalwa kuphela letibhadalisa imali yekufelwa, lokunciphisa kancane imali loyibhadalako kuya emngcwabeni ngekushesha.
eng_text: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Tindiza letiniketa loku tifaka ekhatsi i-Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa futsi titindiza letisuka e-U.S noma e-Canada, nase WestJet.
eng_text: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Kuto tonkhe tikhatsi, kufanele ubhuke ngamakhalekhukhwini wakho ngalokucondzile esiteshini setindiza.
eng_text: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
